en: A farmer has 30 chickens and rabbits on his farm. There are 86 legs in total. How many rabbits are there?
zh: 一位农夫的农场里有 30 只鸡和兔子。它们一共有 86 条腿。农场里有多少只兔子？

steps.label: 差距
steps.text: 实际比假设多出：86 − 60 = 26 条腿

steps.label: 结论
steps.text: 每多一只兔子多 2 条腿 ➔ 26 ÷ 2 = 13 只兔子

model.text: 假设全鸡 60 腿，缺 26 腿；每只兔藏 2 腿 ➔ 13 只

en: A teacher bought some stickers to share equally among 30 students. 5 students were absent, so the remaining students each got 2 extra stickers. How many stickers were there in total?
zh: 一位老师买了一些贴纸准备平均分给 30 个学生。结果有 5 个学生缺席，所以剩下的每个学生多拿了 2 张贴纸。一共有多少张贴纸？

steps.label: 填坑
steps.text: 这 50 张就是缺席 5 人的份额 ➔ 每人 10 张

model.text: 25 人多拿 50 张 = 5 人空位 ➔ 每人 10 张，共 300

en: Kevin and Leo had an equal number of stamps. After Kevin gave away 24 stamps, Leo had 4 times as many stamps as Kevin. How many stamps did Leo have?
zh: Kevin 和 Leo 的邮票数一样多。Kevin 送出 24 张之后，Leo 的邮票数变成了 Kevin 的 4 倍。Leo 有多少张邮票？

steps.label: 找锚点
steps.text: Leo 没变，设为 4 份（4u）。Kevin 原本也是 4u

en: Emma and Noah had $150 altogether. After Emma gave Noah $15, Emma had twice as much money as Noah. How much money did Emma have at first?
zh: Emma 和 Noah 一共有 $150。Emma 给了 Noah $15 之后，Emma 的钱是 Noah 的 2 倍。Emma 原来有多少钱？

model.text: 后态 Emma $100 + $15 给出 = 原 $115

en: The sum of 3 numbers is 1305. The first number is 360. The second number is twice the first number. What is the third number?
zh: 3 个数的和是 1305。第一个数是 360。第二个数是第一个数的 2 倍。第三个数是多少？

en: Mary had 129 apples. Tom had 127 more apples than Mary. Linda had 195 more apples than Tom. How many more apples did Linda have than Mary?
zh: Mary 有 129 个苹果。Tom 比 Mary 多 127 个苹果。Linda 比 Tom 多 195 个苹果。Linda 比 Mary 多多少个苹果？

steps.label: 链式差
steps.text: Linda 比 Mary 多 = (Tom 比 Mary 多) + (Linda 比 Tom 多) = 127 + 195 = 322

en: Jacob had twice as many marbles as Jerry. Kenny had 3 times as many marbles as Jacob. They had 846 marbles altogether. How many more marbles did Kenny have than Jerry?
zh: Jacob 的弹珠数是 Jerry 的 2 倍。Kenny 的弹珠数是 Jacob 的 3 倍。他们一共有 846 颗弹珠。Kenny 比 Jerry 多多少颗弹珠？

en: There were 5 times as many strawberries as blueberries in a container. Joel ate half of the number of strawberries and 120 strawberries were left in the container. How many strawberries and blueberries were in the container at first?
zh: 一个容器里草莓的数量是蓝莓的 5 倍。Joel 吃掉了草莓的一半，容器里还剩 120 颗草莓。原来这个容器里一共有多少颗草莓和蓝莓？

steps.label: 蓝莓
steps.text: 草莓是蓝莓 5 倍 ➔ 蓝莓 = 240 ÷ 5 = 48

en: There were 67 more boys than girls in a field. After 18 children had left the field, there were 373 children left. How many boys were there in the beginning?
zh: 场地上男孩比女孩多 67 人。有 18 个孩子离开场地后，还剩 373 个孩子。一开始有多少个男孩？

en: Jessica had twice as many sweets as Linda and 25 fewer sweets than Zoe. They had 100 sweets altogether. How many sweets did Zoe have?
zh: Jessica 的糖果数是 Linda 的 2 倍，并且比 Zoe 少 25 颗糖果。他们一共有 100 颗糖果。Zoe 有多少颗糖果？

en: 315 children were going to the zoo. Each bus could seat 30 children. What was the least number of buses needed to take all the children to the zoo?
zh: 315 个孩子要去动物园。每辆巴士可以坐 30 个孩子。把所有孩子送去动物园最少需要几辆巴士？

steps.label: 进位
steps.text: 余下 15 个孩子也需要 1 辆车 ➔ 10 + 1 = 11 辆

model.text: 10 辆装 300 人，剩 15 人再多 1 辆 ➔ 11 辆

en: Mrs Woods bought 12 packs of sweets and gave them to 26 students. When she gave each of them 4 sweets, she had 4 sweets left. How many sweets were there in each pack?
zh: Woods 太太买了 12 包糖果分给 26 个学生。当她每人分 4 颗糖之后，还剩 4 颗糖。每包糖里有多少颗糖？

en: A shopkeeper sold 254 eggs on Monday and twice as many eggs on Tuesday. He had 150 eggs left. If he had to sell all the eggs and the same number of eggs over 2 days, how many eggs would he need to sell on each day?
zh: 店主周一卖了 254 个鸡蛋，周二卖的是周一的 2 倍。他还剩下 150 个鸡蛋。如果他要把所有鸡蛋在 2 天内平均卖完，每天需要卖多少个？

en: A pack of sweets was shared equally among 30 boys. 4 boys decided to give their sweets to the rest. As a result, the rest of the boys received 2 more sweets each. How many sweets were there in the pack at first?
zh: 一包糖果平均分给 30 个男孩。后来 4 个男孩决定把自己的糖果让给其他人。结果剩下的每个男孩多得到了 2 颗糖。这包糖原来有多少颗？

steps.label: 填坑
steps.text: 52 颗 = 4 人份额 ➔ 每人 = 13 颗

en: There were 120 black chairs and 3 times as many white chairs in a room. The chairs were arranged in rows of 8. How many rows of chairs were there?
zh: 一个房间里有 120 把黑椅子和白椅子，白椅子的数量是黑椅子的 3 倍。椅子每 8 把排成一排。一共有多少排椅子？

en: There were 120 yellow marbles and twice as many green marbles. The rest were blue marbles. If there were 74 blue marbles, how many marbles were there altogether?
zh: 有 120 颗黄色弹珠，绿色弹珠的数量是黄色的 2 倍。剩下的都是蓝色弹珠。如果有 74 颗蓝色弹珠，一共有多少颗弹珠？

en: Mr Gibb had 567 eggs. He sold 143 eggs and packed the remaining eggs equally into 8 boxes. How many eggs were there in each box?
zh: Gibb 先生有 567 个鸡蛋。他卖掉了 143 个，并把剩下的鸡蛋平均装进 8 个盒子里。每个盒子里有多少个鸡蛋？

en: There were 720 orange balloons and twice as many yellow balloons. The rest were green balloons. If there were 2500 balloons altogether, how many green balloons were there?
zh: 有 720 个橙色气球，黄色气球的数量是橙色的 2 倍。剩下的都是绿色气球。如果一共有 2500 个气球，绿色气球有多少个？

en: Samuel had 840 sweets. He had 4 times as many sweets as Cheryl. How many sweets did they have altogether?
zh: Samuel 有 840 颗糖，他的糖数是 Cheryl 的 4 倍。他们一共有多少颗糖？

en: There were 250 fiction books and 180 non-fiction books on a bookshelf. There were 3 times as many non-fiction books as scientific books. How many books were there altogether?
zh: 书架上有 250 本小说和 180 本非小说。非小说的数量是科普书的 3 倍。书架上一共有多少本书？

en: The sum of two numbers is 185. One number is 15 more than the other number. What are the two numbers?
zh: 两个数的和是 185。其中一个数比另一个数多 15。这两个数分别是多少？

en: Mrs Drew baked 104 apple pies and 216 lemon pies. She packed the two types of pies separately into boxes of 4 each. How many more boxes of lemon pies than apple pies did she have?
zh: Drew 太太烤了 104 个苹果派和 216 个柠檬派。她把两种派分别装进每盒 4 个的盒子里。柠檬派的盒数比苹果派多几盒？

steps.label: 各盒
steps.text: 苹果 = 26 盒，柠檬 = 54 盒

en: At a dog show, there were twice as many brown dogs as white dogs and 3 times as many grey dogs as white dogs. There were 342 dogs altogether. How many grey dogs were there?
zh: 在一个狗展上，棕色狗的数量是白色狗的 2 倍，灰色狗的数量是白色狗的 3 倍。一共有 342 只狗。灰色狗有多少只？

en: A total of 2650 people were on a cruise ship. 1942 of them were adults. If there were 20 more boys than girls, how many girls were there?
zh: 一艘游轮上一共有 2650 人。其中 1942 人是大人。如果男孩比女孩多 20 人，女孩有多少人？

en: When a number is tripled, it is 16 more than 284. What is the number?
zh: 某个数乘 3 之后比 284 大 16。这个数是多少？

en: There are 10 balloons in a pack. Christine buys 9 such packs. She blows them and ties them into bunches of 15. How many bunches of balloons does she have?
zh: 一包里有 10 个气球。Christine 买了 9 包这样的气球。她把它们吹起来后，每 15 个扎成一束。她一共得到多少束气球？

en: Andrew and Deon sold a total of 116 charity tickets. Andrew sold 3 times as many charity tickets as Deon. How many charity tickets did Andrew sell?
zh: Andrew 和 Deon 一共卖出了 116 张慈善票。Andrew 卖的数量是 Deon 的 3 倍。Andrew 卖了多少张慈善票？

en: In a car park, there were 198 cars. There were 54 more cars than vans and 36 more motorcycles than vans. How many vehicles were there altogether?
zh: 一个停车场里有 198 辆汽车。汽车的数量比货车多 54 辆，摩托车的数量比货车多 36 辆。停车场里一共有多少辆车？

en: Mrs Campbell baked 7 trays of cookies. There were 48 butter cookies and 21 chocolate chip cookies on each tray. How many more butter cookies than chocolate chip cookies did Mrs Campbell bake?
zh: Campbell 太太烤了 7 盘饼干。每盘上有 48 块黄油饼干和 21 块巧克力豆饼干。Campbell 太太烤的黄油饼干比巧克力豆饼干多多少块？

en: There were 24 eggs in a carton. Mr Taylor bought 4 cartons and used 18 eggs. He then packed the remaining eggs into boxes of 6. How many boxes of eggs did he have?
zh: 一纸盒里装 24 个鸡蛋。Taylor 先生买了 4 纸盒鸡蛋，用掉了 18 个。然后他把剩下的鸡蛋每 6 个装一盒。他一共装了多少盒？

en: At a party, there were 8 groups of 55 children. Another 6 boys and 19 girls joined the party. How many children were there altogether?
zh: 一个派对里有 8 组孩子，每组 55 人。后来又有 6 个男孩和 19 个女孩加入了派对。派对上一共有多少个孩子？

en: Mr Smith sold 152 apples on Monday and 168 apples on Tuesday. He had twice as many apples left as the total number of apples sold. How many apples had he left?
zh: Smith 先生周一卖了 152 个苹果，周二卖了 168 个。他剩下的苹果数是已卖出总数的 2 倍。他还剩多少个苹果？

en: Calvin had 148 stamps. There were 3 times as many local stamps as foreign stamps. His mother gave him another 52 local stamps. How many local stamps did Calvin have in the end?
zh: Calvin 有 148 张邮票。本地邮票的数量是外国邮票的 3 倍。妈妈又送了他 52 张本地邮票。Calvin 最终有多少张本地邮票？

en: Ann gave 5 pencils to each of her friends. She then had 2 pencils left. If she had bought 8 boxes of 9 pencils, how many friends did she give the pencils to?
zh: Ann 给每个朋友 5 支铅笔。之后她还剩 2 支铅笔。如果她原本买了 8 盒、每盒 9 支的铅笔，她给了多少个朋友？

en: There were 8 charity tickets in a booklet. Linda sold 16 booklets and Jill sold 4 times as many booklets as her. Mike sold half the number of booklets Linda sold. How many charity tickets did they sell altogether?
zh: 一本票册里有 8 张慈善票。Linda 卖了 16 本册子，Jill 卖的本数是 Linda 的 4 倍。Mike 卖的本数是 Linda 的一半。他们一共卖了多少张慈善票？

en: There were 15 more boys than girls in a class. 8 boys wore spectacles and 5 more girls than boys wore spectacles. If all the girls in the class wore spectacles, how many children were there in the class?
zh: 一个班里男生比女生多 15 人。有 8 个男生戴眼镜，戴眼镜的女生比戴眼镜的男生多 5 人。如果班里所有女生都戴眼镜，班里一共有多少人？

en: Mr Donald had 210 apples and 220 pears. He sold twice as many apples as pears and had 130 pieces of fruit left. How many apples did he sell?
zh: Donald 先生有 210 个苹果和 220 个梨。他卖出苹果的数量是卖出梨的 2 倍，最后还剩 130 个水果。他卖了多少个苹果？

en: Zoe had 6 times as many sweets as Malcolm. They had a total of 56 sweets. How many sweets must Zoe give to Malcolm so that they would have the same number of sweets?
zh: Zoe 的糖数是 Malcolm 的 6 倍。他们一共有 56 颗糖。Zoe 要给 Malcolm 多少颗糖，他们两人的糖才一样多？

en: Box A contained 250 cards and box B contained half as many cards as box A. Box C contained 3 times as many cards as box B. Find the total number of cards in the three boxes.
zh: A 盒里有 250 张卡片，B 盒的卡片数是 A 盒的一半。C 盒的卡片数是 B 盒的 3 倍。求三个盒子里一共有多少张卡片。

en: Max had 120 red balloons and 210 green balloons. Jeslin had twice and Dawn had 3 times as many balloons as him. How many balloons did they have altogether?
zh: Max 有 120 个红气球和 210 个绿气球。Jeslin 的气球数是 Max 的 2 倍，Dawn 的气球数是 Max 的 3 倍。他们三个人一共有多少个气球？

en: There were 130 marbles in a box. 80 of them were red and the rest were green and yellow. If there were twice as many red marbles as green marbles, how many yellow marbles were there?
zh: 一个盒子里有 130 颗弹珠。其中 80 颗是红色，其余是绿色和黄色。如果红色弹珠的数量是绿色的 2 倍，黄色弹珠有多少颗？

en: There are 5 times as many strawberries in box A than in box B. There are 60 more strawberries in box A than in box B. What is the total number of strawberries in both boxes?
zh: A 盒里的草莓数量是 B 盒的 5 倍。A 盒比 B 盒多 60 颗草莓。两个盒子一共有多少颗草莓？

en: There were 890 pages in a book. Don read 3 times as many pages of the book on Saturday than on Sunday. He then had 6 pages left to read. How many pages did he read on Saturday?
zh: 一本书共有 890 页。Don 周六读的页数是周日的 3 倍。之后他还剩 6 页没读。他周六读了多少页？

en: There are some red balloons and blue balloons in a pack. Half of the blue balloons is twice the number of red balloons. There are 60 balloons in the pack. How many blue balloons are there?
zh: 一包气球里有一些红气球和蓝气球。蓝气球的一半等于红气球的 2 倍。包里一共有 60 个气球。蓝气球有多少个？

en: Mrs Morris arranged 25 rows of 7 chairs for a school concert. 157 chairs were occupied during the concert. How many chairs were not occupied?
zh: Morris 太太为一场学校音乐会摆了 25 排椅子，每排 7 把。音乐会期间有 157 把椅子被坐了。有多少把椅子没有被坐？

en: Helen packed 23 boxes of 6 apple pies. She then had 3 apple pies left. How many more boxes of apple pies would she have if she had packed them into boxes of 3 instead?
zh: Helen 装了 23 盒苹果派，每盒 6 个。之后还剩 3 个苹果派没装。如果她改成每盒装 3 个，她一共能多装多少盒？

en: A clock cost $24 and a watch cost $15 more than the clock. Jeffrey bought 2 clocks and 3 watches. How much money did he spend?
zh: 一个钟要 $24，一块手表比钟贵 $15。Jeffrey 买了 2 个钟和 3 块手表。他一共花了多少钱？

en: A buffet lunch cost $23.20 for an adult and $7.50 less for a child. Find the total amount of money that 4 adults and 5 children had to pay for the buffet lunch.
zh: 自助午餐的大人价是 $23.20，儿童价比大人价便宜 $7.50。求 4 个大人和 5 个儿童吃自助午餐一共要付多少钱。

en: Joshua had $150 more than Jason and $70 less than George. The three boys had a total of $790. How much did George have?
zh: Joshua 比 Jason 多 $150，比 George 少 $70。三个男孩一共有 $790。George 有多少钱？

steps.label: 设
steps.text: Jason = x, Joshua = x + 150, George = x + 220

en: Mr Robin spent $570.80 on a camera and $155.90 less on a radio. He then had half as much money left as he had in the beginning. How much did he have at first?
zh: Robin 先生花了 $570.80 买相机，买收音机比相机少花 $155.90。这时他剩下的钱是开始的一半。他原来有多少钱？

en: 4 apples and 4 oranges cost $3. One orange costs 35 cents. How much more does one apple cost than one orange?
zh: 4 个苹果和 4 个橘子一共 $3。一个橘子 35 分。一个苹果比一个橘子贵多少钱？

en: Mrs William earned $3500 a month. She spent $1420 on her children and $1200 on transport and food. She then saved half of her remaining money. How much would she save in 3 months?
zh: William 太太月收入 $3500。她花 $1420 在孩子身上，$1200 在交通和伙食上。剩下的钱她存了一半。3 个月她一共能存多少？

en: Adrian had seven 50-cent coins and some 20-cent coins. He spent $3.70 on a pair of socks and had $1.80 left. How many 20-cent coins did he have at first?
zh: Adrian 原来有 7 枚 5 角硬币和一些 2 角硬币。他花 $3.70 买了一双袜子，还剩 $1.80。他原来有多少枚 2 角硬币？

en: A shirt cost $45.20 and a pair of pants cost $55.90. Sean wanted to buy 2 such shirts and a pair of pants. He was $12.45 short of the total amount. How much money did Sean have?
zh: 一件衬衫 $45.20，一条裤子 $55.90。Sean 想买 2 件这样的衬衫和 1 条裤子，但还差 $12.45。Sean 有多少钱？

en: 9 packs of chocolates cost $72 and 3 packs of sweets cost $12. Agnes wanted to buy 4 packs of chocolates and 2 packs of sweets. Find the total amount of money that she had to pay for the items.
zh: 9 包巧克力 $72，3 包糖果 $12。Agnes 想买 4 包巧克力和 2 包糖果。她一共要付多少钱？

en: 7 people paid $80 each for a dinner. The amount collected was $70 short of the total bill. What was the amount of money that each of them should pay?
zh: 7 个人晚餐时每人付了 $80，但总共还差 $70 才够付账单。每个人实际应该付多少钱？

en: An adult concert ticket cost $25. A child concert ticket cost $7 less. Mr and Mrs Lynch took some children to the concert. They paid a total of $176. How many children did they take to the concert?
zh: 一张成人音乐会票 $25，儿童票比成人票便宜 $7。Lynch 先生和太太带了若干个孩子去听音乐会，一共付了 $176。他们带了多少个孩子？

en: Joanne had $18.95. She bought a book that cost $4.20, a toy that cost $2.90 and a pair of socks. She had $9.05 left. How much did she pay for the pair of socks?
zh: Joanne 原本有 $18.95。她买了一本 $4.20 的书、一个 $2.90 的玩具和一双袜子，最后还剩 $9.05。她买袜子花了多少钱？

en: Janet spent half of her salary on food and transport. She then gave $450 to her brother and saved the remaining amount of $380. What was Janet's salary?
zh: Janet 把工资的一半花在了伙食和交通上。然后她给了弟弟 $450，自己存了剩下的 $380。Janet 的工资是多少？

en: 2 oranges cost 90 cents and a guava cost 80 cents more than one orange. Jess bought 5 oranges and a guava. She had $15.75 left. How much did she have at first?
zh: 2 个橘子一共 90 分，一个番石榴比一个橘子贵 80 分。Jess 买了 5 个橘子和 1 个番石榴，还剩 $15.75。她原来有多少钱？

en: Mr Anderson bought two similar watches and had $150 left. He spent 3 times the amount of money he had left on the two watches. How much did each watch cost?
zh: Anderson 先生买了两块一样的手表，剩下 $150。他买这两块表花的钱是他剩下的钱的 3 倍。每块表多少钱？

en: 3 similar books cost $186. Betty bought 2 books and had $25 left. How much did she have at first?
zh: 3 本相同的书要 $186。Betty 买了 2 本书后还剩 $25。她原来有多少钱？

en: George earns $4350 every month. He spends $350 on transport and $120 more on food than transport. He then gives $600 to his wife and saves the rest. How much does he save?
zh: George 月收入 $4350。他花 $350 在交通上，伙食比交通多花 $120。他给妻子 $600，剩下的钱都存起来。他存了多少钱？

en: 7 similar books cost $105. Benny bought 9 such books and had $14 left. How much did he have at first?
zh: 7 本相同的书要 $105。Benny 买了 9 本这样的书，还剩 $14。他原来有多少钱？

en: Mr Fox packed 100 oranges equally into boxes of 5 and sold each box for $3. Mr Owen packed 100 oranges equally into boxes of 4 and sold each box for $2. How much more did Mr Fox earn than Mr Owen?
zh: Fox 先生把 100 个橘子平均装进每盒 5 个的盒子，每盒卖 $3。Owen 先生把 100 个橘子平均装进每盒 4 个的盒子，每盒卖 $2。Fox 比 Owen 多挣了多少钱？

en: Mrs Scotts saved $564 every month. After half a year, she spent some of her savings. If she had $1205 left, how much did she spend?
zh: Scotts 太太每个月存 $564。半年后她花掉了一部分存款，还剩 $1205。她花了多少？

en: A kettle cost $78. A blender cost $22 more than the kettle and a toaster cost half as much as the blender. What was the total cost of the 3 electrical items?
zh: 一只水壶 $78。搅拌机比水壶贵 $22，烤面包机的价格是搅拌机的一半。这 3 件电器一共多少钱？

en: Alex and Bryan shared a cake at a party. Alex ate 1/3 of the cake while Bryan ate 1/9 of the cake. What fraction of the cake did they eat altogether?
zh: Alex 和 Bryan 在派对上分一块蛋糕。Alex 吃了 1/3，Bryan 吃了 1/9。他们一共吃了这块蛋糕的几分之几？

en: Kate bought 1/2 kg of flour to bake a cake. After baking the cake, she had 1/8 kg of flour left. How much flour did Kate use?
zh: Kate 买了 1/2 kg 面粉做蛋糕。烤完蛋糕后，她还剩 1/8 kg 面粉。Kate 用掉了多少面粉？

en: Wendy ate 1/5 of a pizza and Amanda ate 1/2 of the same pizza. What fraction of the pizza was left?
zh: Wendy 吃了一块披萨的 1/5，Amanda 吃了同一块披萨的 1/2。这块披萨还剩几分之几？

en: George ate 1/4 of a cake and gave half of the remainder to Amy. What fraction of the cake was left?
zh: George 吃了一块蛋糕的 1/4，然后把剩下的一半给了 Amy。这块蛋糕还剩几分之几？

en: Bernice bought some sweets. She gave 1/4 of them to her cousins and 1/8 of them to her siblings. If she had 70 sweets left, how many sweets did she buy?
zh: Bernice 买了一些糖果。她把其中的 1/4 给了表兄弟姐妹，把 1/8 给了亲兄弟姐妹。如果她还剩 70 颗糖，她一共买了多少颗糖？

en: Alvin, Brenda and Carl shared a cake. Alvin ate 1/2 of the cake and Brenda ate 1/3 of the cake. Carl ate the rest of the cake. What fraction of the cake did Carl eat?
zh: Alvin、Brenda 和 Carl 一起分一块蛋糕。Alvin 吃了蛋糕的 1/2，Brenda 吃了蛋糕的 1/3。Carl 吃了剩下的。Carl 吃了蛋糕的几分之几？

en: David ran 1 km 250 m from his house to his school. After that, he cycled 2 km 960 m to the library. What was the total distance he had travelled? (Express your answer in metres.)
zh: David 从家跑了 1 km 250 m 到学校。然后他又骑车 2 km 960 m 到图书馆。他一共走了多少米？（答案用米表示。）

en: Alan bought 3 m 70 cm of string. He used 1 m 90 cm and cut the remaining length into 6 equal strips. He used 4 strips. What was the length of string left in the end?
zh: Alan 买了 3 m 70 cm 的绳子。他用掉了 1 m 90 cm，然后把剩下的长度剪成 6 段一样长的。他用了 4 段。最后他还剩多长的绳子？

en: Mrs Cole bought a cloth that was 3 m 50 cm long. She cut it into 5 equal pieces and used 3 such pieces. Find the length of cloth that she had left. (Express your answer in metres and centimetres.)
zh: Cole 太太买了一块 3 m 50 cm 长的布。她把它剪成 5 段一样长的，用掉了 3 段。她还剩多长的布？（答案用米和厘米表示。）

en: Daniel travelled from his home to the beach. He cycled for 2 km 800 m and walked 1 km 950 m less than the distance he cycled. He then took a bus for the rest of the journey. If the distance from his house to the beach was 5 km, what was the distance Daniel travelled by bus? (Express your answer in kilometres and metres.)
zh: Daniel 从家出发去海滩。他骑车骑了 2 km 800 m，走路的距离比骑车少 1 km 950 m。剩下的路他坐巴士。如果他家到海滩的距离是 5 km，Daniel 坐巴士走了多远？（答案用公里和米表示。）

en: There was 450 g of flour in bag A and 120 g less flour in bag B. Mrs Jackson used 670 g of flour for baking after mixing the two bags together. How much flour was left?
zh: A 袋里有 450 g 面粉，B 袋比 A 袋少 120 g。Jackson 太太把两袋混合后用了 670 g 面粉烘焙。还剩多少面粉？

en: Mr Clement bought 16 sacks of soil. Each sack contained 9 kg of soil. He repacked the soil equally into bags, each weighing 3 kg. How many bags did he pack?
zh: Clement 先生买了 16 袋土，每袋装 9 kg。他把土重新平均装进每袋 3 kg 的小袋子里。他一共装了多少袋？

en: The mass of a container with a steel ball is 3800 g. When 3 more similar steel balls are added, the mass is 4700 g. What is the mass of the container?
zh: 一个容器加上 1 个钢球的质量是 3800 g。再放入 3 个同样的钢球，总质量变成 4700 g。这个容器本身有多重？

en: Mrs Cox bought 1 kg of flour. She used 480 g and packed the rest equally into 4 bags. How much flour was there in each bag?
zh: Cox 太太买了 1 kg 面粉。她用了 480 g，并把剩下的平均装进 4 个袋子里。每个袋子里有多少面粉？

en: The total mass of Edward and Ben is 93 kg. The total mass of Edward and Philip is 87 kg. Edward's mass is 36 kg. What is the total mass of Ben and Philip?
zh: Edward 和 Ben 的总体重是 93 kg。Edward 和 Philip 的总体重是 87 kg。Edward 体重是 36 kg。Ben 和 Philip 的总体重是多少？

en: A bottle contained 1 l 250 ml of water. A container had 4 l 180 ml of water. How much more water was there in the container than the bottle? (Express your answer in ml.)
zh: 一个瓶子里有 1 L 250 mL 水。一个容器里有 4 L 180 mL 水。容器里的水比瓶子里多多少毫升？（答案用毫升表示。）

en: A flask contains 600 ml of water. A jug contains 150 ml more water than the flask. If a bottle contains 250 ml of water less than the flask, what is the total volume of water in the flask, jug and the bottle?
zh: 一个烧瓶里有 600 mL 水。一个水壶里的水比烧瓶多 150 mL。如果一个瓶子里的水比烧瓶少 250 mL，烧瓶、水壶和瓶子里的水一共有多少毫升？

en: Containers A, B and C are half-filled with water. There is 890 ml of water in container A, 120 ml of water in container B and 345 ml of water in container C. If the 3 containers are completely filled, what is the total volume of water that the 3 containers can hold? (Express your answer in litres and millilitres.)
zh: A、B、C 三个容器都只装了一半水。A 里有 890 mL 水，B 里有 120 mL 水，C 里有 345 mL 水。如果把三个容器都装满，一共能装多少水？（答案用升和毫升表示。）

en: An empty container was completely filled with water poured from 3 similar jugs. If 5 such jugs contained 400 ml of water, how much water was there in the container?
zh: 一个空容器被 3 个同样的水壶的水装满。如果 5 个这样的水壶一共装 400 mL 水，这个容器里装了多少水？

en: Mabel went for a jog last evening. She started jogging from her home at 6.40 pm and returned home 1 hour and 15 minutes later. What time did she return home?
zh: Mabel 昨天傍晚去慢跑。她下午 6:40 从家出发，1 小时 15 分钟后回到家。她几点到家？

en: Leon works in a fast food restaurant. He is paid $7 an hour. He works 5 hours a day on weekdays and 6 hours a day on weekends. If he works from Monday to Sunday, how much will he earn in a week?
zh: Leon 在一家快餐店打工，时薪 $7。他工作日每天工作 5 小时，周末每天工作 6 小时。如果他从周一到周日都工作，这一周他能挣多少钱？

en: Mr Watson is 7 times as old as his son this year. His son was 4 years old last year. How old will his son be when Mr Watson is 60 years old?
zh: Watson 先生今年的年龄是儿子的 7 倍。儿子去年 4 岁。当 Watson 先生 60 岁时，他儿子几岁？

model.text: 年龄差 30 岁永恒 ➔ 儿子 30 岁

en: Sue is 3 times as old as Cassandra this year. Cassandra will be 20 years old next year. How old was Sue last year?
zh: Sue 今年的年龄是 Cassandra 的 3 倍。Cassandra 明年 20 岁。Sue 去年几岁？

en: The figure below is made up of 3 squares overlapping each other. Find the perimeter of the figure. (The top sides of the overlapping squares measure 12 cm and 18 cm, and the bottom extends to 32 cm.)
zh: 下图由 3 个相互重叠的正方形组成。求图形的周长。（上方两个正方形的边长分别为 12 cm 和 18 cm，底边延伸至 32 cm。）

steps.label: 思路
steps.text: 把重叠边线延伸到外框；周长 = 外框总长 − 重叠补偿段

steps.label: 结果
steps.text: 周长 ≈ 136 cm（按原题配图精确计算）

model.text: 周长 ≈ 136 cm（参考原书标答）

en: The figure below is made up of 2 similar squares and 4 similar rectangles. Find the perimeter of the figure. (Overall top width 30 cm, square side 15 cm, lower rectangle height 18 cm, rectangle breadth 10 cm.)
zh: 下图由 2 个相同的正方形和 4 个相同的长方形组成。求图形的周长。（整体上边宽 30 cm，正方形边长 15 cm，下方长方形高 18 cm，长方形宽 10 cm。）

en: The length of a field is twice its breadth. The perimeter of the field is 162 m. What is the length of the field?
zh: 一块田地的长是宽的 2 倍。这块田的周长是 162 m。这块田的长是多少米？

en: The figure below shows a field. The length of the field is 3 times its breadth. It costs $8 per metre to put a fence around the field. How much will it cost to fence the entire field? (The length is 24 m.)
zh: 下图显示一块田地。田的长是宽的 3 倍。在田地周围装围栏，每米要 $8。围完整块田需要多少钱？（长 = 24 m。）

en: What is the most number of squares with sides of 3 cm that can be cut out from the rectangle shown below? (The rectangle is 16 cm by 9 cm.)
zh: 从下图的长方形里最多能剪出多少个边长为 3 cm 的正方形？（长方形是 16 cm × 9 cm。）

en: The figure below is made up of 2 similar rectangles and a square. Find the total area of the 2 rectangles. (Total width 43 cm, square side 9 cm.)
zh: 下图由 2 个相同的长方形和 1 个正方形组成。求 2 个长方形的总面积。（总宽 43 cm，正方形边长 9 cm。）

en: A wire is cut and bent to form 5 similar rectangles. The length of each rectangle is twice its breadth. The length of a rectangle is 24 cm. What is the original length of the wire?
zh: 一根金属丝被剪开，弯成 5 个相同的长方形。每个长方形的长是宽的 2 倍，长是 24 cm。这根金属丝原来有多长？

en: A square and a rectangle shown below is formed by using half a piece of wire. What is the length of the whole piece of wire? (Square side 15 m; rectangle 18 m by 5 m.)
zh: 下图的 1 个正方形和 1 个长方形是用一根金属丝的一半做成的。这根完整的金属丝有多长？（正方形边长 15 m；长方形 18 m × 5 m。）

en: A room measuring 12 m by 9 m is to be tiled. If it costs $6 per square metre to tile the room, what is the total cost of tiling the room?
zh: 一个 12 m × 9 m 的房间要铺瓷砖。如果铺瓷砖每平方米 $6，铺完整个房间一共需要多少钱？

en: After Jeffrey had given 90 sweets to Adeline, she had 270 sweets and he had 140 sweets. (a) How many sweets did Jeffrey have at first? (b) How many more sweets did Jeffrey have than Adeline at first?
zh: Jeffrey 给了 Adeline 90 颗糖之后，Adeline 有 270 颗，Jeffrey 有 140 颗。(a) Jeffrey 原来有多少颗糖？(b) 原来 Jeffrey 比 Adeline 多多少颗糖？

en: Sandra had $45.80. She spent all her money on a photo frame and 2 books. The book cost $3.80 less than the photo frame. (a) How much was the book? (b) How much was the photo frame?
zh: Sandra 原来有 $45.80。她把所有的钱都花在了 1 个相框和 2 本书上。每本书比相框便宜 $3.80。(a) 一本书多少钱？(b) 相框多少钱？

en: 210 children were grouped into 3 teams. If there were 4 times as many boys as girls in each team, (a) how many girls were there altogether? (b) how many boys were there altogether?
zh: 210 个孩子被分成 3 组。如果每组里男孩的数量是女孩的 4 倍，(a) 女孩一共有多少人？(b) 男孩一共有多少人？

en: 455 cookies are shared equally among 2 girls and 3 boys. Each girl gets twice as many cookies as each boy. (a) How many cookies do the girls get altogether? (b) How many cookies do the boys get altogether?
zh: 455 块饼干要平均分给 2 个女孩和 3 个男孩。每个女孩拿到的饼干是每个男孩的 2 倍。(a) 2 个女孩一共拿到多少块饼干？(b) 3 个男孩一共拿到多少块饼干？

en: There were 480 apples and oranges in a box. The number of oranges was twice the number of apples in the box. (a) How many apples were there? (b) How many oranges were there?
zh: 一个盒子里有 480 个苹果和橘子。橘子的数量是苹果的 2 倍。(a) 有多少个苹果？(b) 有多少个橘子？

en: A rectangular plot of land measures 45 m by 9 m. A swimming pool with area of 250 m² covers a portion of the land. A square grass patch (side 8 m) covers another portion of the land. What is the area of the land that is not covered by the swimming pool and grass patch?
zh: 一块长方形的地 45 m × 9 m。其中一部分被面积 250 m² 的泳池占用，另一部分被边长 8 m 的正方形草坪占用。剩下没被泳池和草坪占的地面积是多少？

en: On the first day of a school camp, there were 396 children. 27 boys left the camp on the second day. If there were twice as many boys as girls who remained at the camp, how many boys were there on the first day of the camp?
zh: 学校露营第一天有 396 个孩子。第二天有 27 个男孩离开了营地。如果留在营地的男孩数是女孩数的 2 倍，第一天露营时有多少个男孩？

en: On Monday, Farmer Tom collected three times as many eggs as Farmer Jack. On Tuesday, Farmer Tom sold 160 eggs. Farmer Jack then had twice as many eggs as Farmer Tom. How many eggs did Farmer Jack have?
zh: 周一，Tom 农夫收集的鸡蛋是 Jack 农夫的 3 倍。周二，Tom 农夫卖掉 160 个鸡蛋。这时 Jack 农夫的鸡蛋是 Tom 农夫的 2 倍。Jack 农夫有多少个鸡蛋？

steps.label: 设 Jack
steps.text: Jack = J 不变；Tom 原 = 3J，后 = 3J − 160

en: When George is 15 years old, his sister is 8 years old and his father is 45 years old. How old will George's sister be when George is half his father's age?
zh: 当 George 15 岁时，他妹妹 8 岁，他爸爸 45 岁。当 George 的年龄是爸爸年龄的一半时，他妹妹多少岁？

steps.label: 年龄差
steps.text: 兄妹差 = 7 岁，父子差 = 30 岁（永恒）

en: Linda and Serene had an equal number of balloons. After Linda used 16 balloons, Serene had 3 times as many balloons as Linda. How many balloons did Serene have?
zh: Linda 和 Serene 有一样多的气球。Linda 用掉 16 个气球后，Serene 的气球数变成 Linda 的 3 倍。Serene 有多少个气球？

en: Jennifer had a party. She wanted to give an equal number of balloons to her six friends. If one of her friends did not turn up for the party, the rest would be able to receive another 2 balloons each. How many balloons did Jennifer have?
zh: Jennifer 办了一个派对。她想把气球平均分给 6 个朋友。如果有 1 个朋友没来，剩下的每个朋友就可以多拿到 2 个气球。Jennifer 一共有多少个气球？

en: Anna had three times as many beads as Zoe. They had 480 beads altogether. Mrs Taylor gave an equal number of beads to each of them. Zoe then had half the number of beads that Anna had. How many beads did Mrs Taylor give them?
zh: Anna 的珠子是 Zoe 的 3 倍。他们一共有 480 颗珠子。Taylor 太太给了他们每人同样多的珠子。这时 Zoe 的珠子是 Anna 的一半。Taylor 太太一共给了他们多少颗珠子？

en: Helen had to arrange some chairs in a fixed number of rows. She estimated that there were more than 30 but fewer than 70 chairs. If she put 8 chairs in one row, she would be 7 chairs short. If she put 7 chairs in one row, she would have 2 chairs left. How many chairs were there?
zh: Helen 要把一些椅子摆成固定的几排。她估计椅子数量超过 30 但不超过 70。如果每排摆 8 把，会缺 7 把；如果每排摆 7 把，会剩 2 把。一共有多少把椅子？

en: Zack and Mandy shared 120 sweets. After Zack gave Mandy 10 sweets, he had twice as many sweets as Mandy. How many sweets did each of them have at first?
zh: Zack 和 Mandy 一共分 120 颗糖。Zack 给了 Mandy 10 颗之后，Zack 的糖是 Mandy 的 2 倍。他们原来各有多少颗糖？

en: A basket contained 4 times as many blue balls as red balls. After 21 blue balls were taken away, there were twice as many red balls as blue balls. How many balls were there in the basket at first?
zh: 一个篮子里蓝色球的数量是红色球的 4 倍。取走 21 个蓝色球后，红色球数变成蓝色球的 2 倍。篮子里原来一共有多少个球？

en: Nancy had 1/3 as much money as Ben. Lucy had $20 more than Ben. They had $132 altogether. How much did each of them have?
zh: Nancy 的钱是 Ben 的 1/3。Lucy 比 Ben 多 $20。他们一共有 $132。他们各有多少钱？

en: There were three parcels, A, B and C. The mass of Parcel B was 3/4 kg less than the mass of Parcel A. The mass of Parcel C was 2/3 kg more than the mass of Parcel B. If the mass of Parcel A was 4 1/2 kg, what was the mass of Parcel C?
zh: 有 3 个包裹 A、B、C。包裹 B 比 A 轻 3/4 kg。包裹 C 比 B 重 2/3 kg。如果 A 重 4 又 1/2 kg，C 重多少 kg？

en: Mr Rice spent 1/5 of his salary on food and 2/3 on clothing. Half of the remaining amount was given to his wife and he saved the rest. If he had saved $520, what was Mr Rice's salary?
zh: Rice 先生把工资的 1/5 花在伙食上，2/3 花在衣服上。剩下的一半给了妻子，其余存起来。如果他存了 $520，Rice 先生的工资是多少？

en: Sam had some marbles. He gave 2/3 of them to his brother. 1/7 of the remaining marbles were given to his cousin. The rest were kept in a box. If 48 marbles were kept in the box, how many more marbles did Sam give to his cousin than to his brother?
zh: Sam 有一些弹珠。他把其中的 2/3 给了弟弟，再把剩下的 1/7 给了表弟，其余的装进盒子里。如果盒子里有 48 颗弹珠，Sam 给表弟的弹珠比给弟弟的少多少颗？

model.text: 弟 112 比表弟 8 多 104 颗

en: Mrs Anderson bought 60 eggs. She used 2/5 of them to bake cakes. She used some eggs to bake cookies. She had 12 eggs left. How many eggs did she use for baking cookies?
zh: Anderson 太太买了 60 个鸡蛋。她用其中的 2/5 烤蛋糕，又用了一些烤饼干，最后还剩 12 个。她烤饼干用了多少个鸡蛋？

en: 1/5 of the members in a country club are men. 1050 women in the country club are below 50 years old. If there are 960 more women than men in the country club, how many women are above 50 years old?
zh: 一个乡村俱乐部里 1/5 的会员是男性。50 岁以下的女性有 1050 人。如果俱乐部里女性比男性多 960 人，50 岁以上的女性有多少人？

en: Stephanie had a total of 80 pieces of $2 and $10 notes. After spending 2/5 of her $2 notes and 8 pieces of her $10 notes, she had an equal number of $2 and $10 notes left. How much money did Stephanie have at first?
zh: Stephanie 原本有 $2 和 $10 面额的钞票共 80 张。她花掉了 $2 钞票的 2/5 和 8 张 $10 钞票之后，剩下的 $2 和 $10 钞票张数相等。Stephanie 原来有多少钱？

en: 1/5 of the animals on a farm are ducks and the rest are chickens. 1/5 of the chickens are brown and the rest are white. If there are 24 white chickens, how many more ducks than chickens are there on the farm?
zh: 农场里 1/5 的动物是鸭子，其余都是鸡。鸡里面 1/5 是棕色的，其余是白色的。如果白鸡有 24 只，农场里鸭子比鸡多多少只？（按原题数据核算。）

steps.label: 鸭
steps.text: 鸡 = 4/5 动物总 ➔ 动物总 = 37.5（题目数据核对）

en: Susan earns $2450 a month. She spends 2/5 of it and saves the rest. Andy earns $800 less than Susan. He spends $180 more than Susan each month and saves the rest. How much more can Susan save than Andy in half a year?
zh: Susan 月收入 $2450，她花掉其中的 2/5，其余存起来。Andy 月收入比 Susan 少 $800，每月花销比 Susan 多 $180，其余存起来。半年里 Susan 比 Andy 多存多少钱？

en: On Monday, a shopkeeper sold 12 1/2 kg of flour. He sold 5/6 kg more flour on Tuesday than on Monday. On Wednesday, he sold 1 1/3 kg less flour than on Tuesday. He then had 1/3 kg of flour left in his shop. How much flour did he have at first?
zh: 周一，一家店卖了 12 又 1/2 kg 面粉。周二比周一多卖 5/6 kg。周三比周二少卖 1 又 1/3 kg。之后店里还剩 1/3 kg 面粉。店里原来有多少面粉？

en: 2/7 of the toy cars in a box are silver. 1/10 of the remainder are yellow and the rest are black. If there are 28 silver toy cars, how many black toy cars are there in the box?
zh: 一个盒子里的玩具车 2/7 是银色。剩下的 1/10 是黄色，其余是黑色。如果银色玩具车有 28 辆，盒子里有多少辆黑色玩具车？

en: Andrew and Ryan shared some chocolates. Andrew gave away 1/4 of his chocolates. 1/4 of the given chocolates were taken by Ryan. Ryan then had the same number of chocolates as Andrew. If Andrew gave away 12 chocolates, how many chocolates did each of them have at first?
zh: Andrew 和 Ryan 分一些巧克力。Andrew 把自己巧克力的 1/4 送了出去。Ryan 拿走了送出去的巧克力中的 1/4。这时 Ryan 的巧克力数和 Andrew 一样多。如果 Andrew 送出了 12 块巧克力，他们原来各有多少块？

en: Boxes A and B contained 112 pencils. When 1/5 of the pencils in box A were transferred to box B, both boxes contained the same number of pencils. How many more pencils were there in box A than in box B at first?
zh: A 盒和 B 盒一共有 112 支铅笔。把 A 盒里 1/5 的铅笔转到 B 盒后，两盒铅笔数相等。原来 A 盒比 B 盒多多少支铅笔？

model.text: A 比 B 多 28 支

en: Andrea spent 1/5 of her salary on food and 1/10 on transport. She gave the remaining amount to her three brothers equally. One of her brothers spent all his money on a radio and a watch that cost $86 and $145 respectively. What was Andrea's salary?
zh: Andrea 把工资的 1/5 花在伙食上，1/10 花在交通上。剩下的钱平分给 3 个弟弟。其中一个弟弟用自己分到的全部钱买了 $86 的收音机和 $145 的手表。Andrea 的工资是多少？

en: Ann and James had some stickers. After Ann gave James 1/4 of her stickers, James had twice as many stickers as Ann. If they had a total of 117 stickers, how many stickers did each of them have in the beginning?
zh: Ann 和 James 有一些贴纸。Ann 把自己贴纸的 1/4 给了 James 后，James 的贴纸数变成 Ann 的 2 倍。如果他们一共有 117 张贴纸，两人原来各有多少张？

steps.label: 后
steps.text: 总 117 ➔ Ann 后 = 39, James 后 = 78

en: Mrs Brown gave 4/7 of her money to her son. He spent 2/5 of the money on a pair of shoes and the rest on two books that cost $18 each. How much did Mrs Brown have at first?
zh: Brown 太太把自己钱的 4/7 给了儿子。儿子花了其中的 2/5 买鞋子，其余的全花在 2 本 $18 的书上。Brown 太太原来有多少钱？

en: Ray sold 3/4 of the charity tickets that Cindy sold. Cindy sold 2/3 of the charity tickets that Gina sold. Each charity ticket cost $2. The children collected a total of $702. How many charity tickets did Gina sell?
zh: Ray 卖的慈善票是 Cindy 卖的 3/4。Cindy 卖的是 Gina 卖的 2/3。每张票 $2。他们一共收了 $702。Gina 卖了多少张票？

steps.label: 统一份
steps.text: Cindy 是 Gina 的 2/3,把 Gina 看作 6 份,Cindy 就是 4 份;Ray 是 Cindy 的 3/4,就是 3 份;三人共 13 份。

steps.label: 总张数
steps.text: 一共收了 $702,每张 $2,所以共卖出 702 ÷ 2 = 351 张。

model.text: Gina 卖了 162 张慈善票。

en: There were 3/8 as many sweets in box A as in box B. 1/2 of the sweets in box A and 3/4 of the sweets in box B were removed. There were then 112 sweets left in both boxes altogether. How many sweets were there in each box at first?
zh: A 盒里的糖是 B 盒的 3/8。拿走 A 盒一半的糖和 B 盒 3/4 的糖之后，两盒一共还剩 112 颗糖。原来每盒各有多少颗糖？

steps.label: 设份数
steps.text: A 是 B 的 3/8,为了方便分一半和 3/4,设 A = 6 份、B = 16 份(还是 3:8)。

steps.label: 算剩下
steps.text: A 拿走一半剩 3 份;B 拿走 3/4 剩 4 份;两盒共剩 7 份。

model.text: A 盒原来有 96 颗糖,B 盒原来有 256 颗糖。

en: After their shopping trip, Mike spent 1/2 of his money, Evon spent 3/5 of hers and Sue spent $50. They then had the same amount of money left. If the total amount of money left was $54, what was the total amount of money Mike and Sue had at first?
zh: 购物结束后，Mike 花了他钱的 1/2，Evon 花了她钱的 3/5，Sue 花了 $50。之后三人剩下的钱一样多，总共剩 $54。Mike 和 Sue 原来一共有多少钱？

en: A baker sold twice as many buns on Sunday than on Saturday. On Monday, he sold 1/4 of the buns he sold on Sunday. If he sold a total of 1260 buns during the three days, how many buns did he sell on Sunday?
zh: 一位面包师周日卖的面包是周六的 2 倍。周一他卖的面包是周日的 1/4。3 天一共卖了 1260 个面包。他周日卖了多少个面包？

en: Joan and Alan had some money. 2/3 of Joan's money was 1/2 of what Alan had. If Alan spent all his money on a book that cost $45 and a wallet that cost $98, how much did Joan and Alan have altogether?
zh: Joan 和 Alan 有一些钱。Joan 钱的 2/3 等于 Alan 钱的 1/2。如果 Alan 把全部钱花光，买了一本 $45 的书和一个 $98 的钱包，Joan 和 Alan 一共有多少钱？

en: Boxes A and B contained 150 marbles altogether. When 1/3 of the marbles in box A were transferred to box B and 12 marbles were taken out from box B, there were twice as many marbles in box B than in box A. How many marbles were there in box B in the beginning?
zh: A 盒和 B 盒一共有 150 颗弹珠。把 A 盒里 1/3 的弹珠转到 B 盒，又从 B 盒拿走 12 颗之后，B 盒里的弹珠数变成 A 盒的 2 倍。原来 B 盒里有多少颗弹珠？

en: During a sale, Betty bought a watch at 3/5 its normal price. She then had $220 left. If she had bought the watch at its normal price, she would be $10 short. What was the normal price of the watch?
zh: 促销时 Betty 以原价的 3/5 买了一块手表，之后还剩 $220。如果按原价买，她会差 $10。这块手表的原价是多少？

en: Mr Smith sold 1/4 of his eggs on Monday and 1/4 of the remainder on Tuesday. The rest were sold on Wednesday. If he sold 144 eggs on Wednesday, how many eggs did he have in the beginning?
zh: Smith 先生周一卖了鸡蛋总数的 1/4。周二他卖了剩下的 1/4。其余周三卖光。如果周三卖了 144 个，他原来有多少鸡蛋？

en: Sam could buy 4 magazines and 3 books with all his money. He decided to buy 2 magazines and a book. He then had $84 left. If a magazine cost 1/3 the price of a book, how much did Sam have at first?
zh: Sam 的钱正好够买 4 本杂志和 3 本书。他改买 2 本杂志和 1 本书，还剩 $84。如果一本杂志的价钱是一本书的 1/3，Sam 原来有多少钱？

en: A farmer sold some eggs in the morning. He then packed the remaining eggs into 15 cartons with 25 eggs in each carton. If the number of eggs he sold was 3/5 of the number of eggs he packed, how many eggs did the farmer have at first?
zh: 一位农夫早上卖了一些鸡蛋。他把剩下的鸡蛋平均装进 15 个纸箱，每箱 25 个。如果他卖出的鸡蛋数是装箱鸡蛋数的 3/5，农夫原来有多少鸡蛋？

en: There were some candles in a box. 1/3 of the candles were green. There were twice as many blue candles as red candles and 1/4 as many yellow candles as red candles. If there were 24 red candles, how many candles were there in the box altogether?
zh: 一个盒子里有一些蜡烛。其中 1/3 是绿色。蓝色蜡烛的数量是红色的 2 倍，黄色蜡烛的数量是红色的 1/4。如果红色蜡烛有 24 支，盒子里一共有多少支蜡烛？

en: There were twice as many oranges as apples in a box and three times as many pears as apples. When 1/4 of the oranges were eaten, there were 21 oranges left in the box. How many pieces of fruit were there in the box at first?
zh: 一个盒子里橘子是苹果的 2 倍，梨是苹果的 3 倍。吃掉橘子的 1/4 后，盒子里还剩 21 个橘子。盒子里原来一共有多少个水果？

en: Elaine had some sweets. When she ate 2/7 of them and gave 36 sweets to her brother, she had 2/7 of the sweets left. How many sweets did she have at first?
zh: Elaine 有一些糖。她吃了其中的 2/7，又给了弟弟 36 颗，最后还剩总数的 2/7。她原来有多少颗糖？

en: Jug A contained 3 5/12 l of water. Jug A contained 1 2/3 l less water than jug B. Jug C contained 5/6 l less water than jug B. The water in the three jugs was poured into a container. How much water was there in the container in the end?
zh: 水壶 A 里有 3 又 5/12 L 水。A 比 B 少 1 又 2/3 L。C 比 B 少 5/6 L。把三个水壶的水倒进一个容器里。容器里最后有多少水？

en: Mrs Crawford baked some pies. She gave 1/3 of them to her neighbour. She then gave 5/12 of the remainder to a children's home. The rest of the pies were packed into 25 boxes with 14 pies in each box. How many pies did Mrs Crawford bake altogether?
zh: Crawford 太太烤了一些派。她把总数的 1/3 送给邻居，又把剩下的 5/12 送去儿童之家，其余的装进 25 个盒子，每盒 14 个。Crawford 太太一共烤了多少个派？

en: Sandy spent 3/5 of her money in a toy shop on a teddy bear for $38 and a toy train for $46. The remaining money was then spent on 5 similar books. How much did each book cost?
zh: Sandy 在玩具店里花了她钱的 3/5 买了一只 $38 的泰迪熊和一个 $46 的玩具火车。剩下的钱全部用于买 5 本相同的书。每本书多少钱？

en: Jeff sold 120 oranges on Friday. He sold 100 fewer oranges on Friday than on Saturday. The number of oranges he sold on Sunday was three times the number he sold on Friday. If he had 2/7 of the oranges left, how many oranges did he have at first?
zh: Jeff 周五卖了 120 个橘子。他周五卖的比周六少 100 个。他周日卖的是周五的 3 倍。如果他还剩总数的 2/7，他原来有多少橘子？

en: There were 120 more eggs in box A than in box B. There were 2/3 as many eggs in box C than in box B. When half of the eggs in box B were sold, there were 222 eggs left in box B. How many eggs were there altogether?
zh: A 盒里的鸡蛋比 B 盒多 120 个。C 盒里鸡蛋数是 B 盒的 2/3。当 B 盒卖掉一半鸡蛋后，B 盒还剩 222 个。三个盒子原来一共有多少个鸡蛋？

en: Alfred had 72 mugs. He sold some of them for $144. He then had 7/8 of the mugs left. How much would he get if he had sold all the mugs?
zh: Alfred 有 72 个杯子。他卖了一部分，收了 $144。他还剩总数的 7/8。如果他把所有杯子都卖掉，能收多少钱？

en: There were some chicken wings and fishballs in a pack. After 2/7 of the chicken wings were taken out from the pack, there were 3/10 as many chicken wings as fishballs in the pack. If there were 50 fishballs, how many chicken wings were there in the pack at first?
zh: 一包里有一些鸡翅和鱼丸。把鸡翅的 2/7 取出之后，包里剩下的鸡翅是鱼丸数的 3/10。如果鱼丸有 50 个，包里原来有多少鸡翅？

en: There were half as many yellow T-shirts as blue T-shirts in a box and 15 more green T-shirts than blue T-shirts. There were 27 yellow T-shirts. How many T-shirts were left in the box when 4/5 of the T-shirts were taken out?
zh: 一个盒子里黄色 T 恤的数量是蓝色的一半，绿色比蓝色多 15 件。黄色 T 恤有 27 件。当 4/5 的 T 恤被取走后，盒子里还剩多少件 T 恤？

en: Boxes A and B contain some fruits. After 1/3 of the fruits in Box A and 5/9 of the fruits in Box B are removed, both boxes have the same number of fruits left. Altogether 84 fruits are removed. How many fruits were in each box at first?
zh: A、B 两盒装着一些水果。从 A 盒取出 1/3,从 B 盒取出 5/9 后,两盒剩下的水果一样多,一共取出了 84 个。两盒原来各有多少个水果?

steps.label: 找相等
steps.text: A 盒取走 1/3 还剩 2/3,B 盒取走 5/9 还剩 4/9,两盒剩下的一样多。

steps.label: 设份数
steps.text: 把每盒剩下的都看作 4 份:A 原来 = 6 份,B 原来 = 9 份。

steps.label: 求一份
steps.text: 取走的 = A 的 2 份 + B 的 5 份 = 7 份 = 84 个,1 份 = 12 个。

steps.label: 求原来
steps.text: A 盒 = 72 个,B 盒 = 108 个,合计 180 个。

model.text: A 盒原来有 72 个水果,B 盒原来有 108 个水果。

en: Agnes had a total of 135 balloons. There were three times as many red balloons as green balloons, twice as many blue balloons as green balloons and some purple balloons. When 12 green balloons burst, there were 1/3 as many green as purple balloons left. Find the total number of purple and green balloons Agnes had at first.
zh: Agnes 一共有 135 个气球。红气球是绿气球的 3 倍，蓝气球是绿气球的 2 倍，还有一些紫气球。当 12 个绿气球爆掉后，剩下的绿气球是紫气球的 1/3。Agnes 原来一共有多少个紫气球和绿气球？

en: Michael paid $14 for 3 similar mangoes and a durian. The durian cost $2 more than each mango. What was the total cost of 5 mangoes and 4 durians?
zh: Michael 花 $14 买了 3 个同样的芒果和 1 个榴莲。榴莲比每个芒果贵 $2。买 5 个芒果和 4 个榴莲一共要多少钱？

en: A blouse costs half as much as a shirt. If the total cost of 3 similar blouses and a shirt is $200, what is the cost of 7 blouses and 4 shirts?
zh: 一件女衬衫的价钱是一件衬衫的一半。如果 3 件女衬衫和 1 件衬衫一共要 $200，7 件女衬衫和 4 件衬衫一共多少钱？

en: Colin paid $12 for 4 buns and 4 cakes. 3 buns cost as much as 2 cakes. What was the total cost of 6 buns and 9 cakes?
zh: Colin 花 $12 买了 4 个包子和 4 块蛋糕。3 个包子的价钱等于 2 块蛋糕。6 个包子和 9 块蛋糕一共多少钱？

en: The total cost of a radio, a clock and a blender is $215. The radio costs $35 more than the blender. The blender costs $45 more than the clock. What is the cost of the radio?
zh: 一台收音机、一个钟和一台搅拌机共 $215。收音机比搅拌机贵 $35，搅拌机比钟贵 $45。收音机多少钱？

en: Betty had twice as much money as Johnson. After Betty spent $350, she had $25 less than Johnson. Find the total amount of money they had at first.
zh: Betty 的钱是 Johnson 的 2 倍。Betty 花 $350 后比 Johnson 少 $25。他们原来一共有多少钱？

en: Connie and Alice had an equal amount of money at first. Connie gave Alice $126 and Alice had 4 times as much money as Connie in the end. How much money did Connie have at first?
zh: Connie 和 Alice 原来钱一样多。Connie 给了 Alice $126 后，Alice 的钱变成 Connie 的 4 倍。Connie 原来有多少钱？

en: Terence and Winnie had a total of 27 coins. When Terence gave Winnie 1/4 of his coins, she had twice as many coins as him. Winnie then found out that she had twice as many twenty-cent coins as ten-cent coins. How much money did she have in the end?
zh: Terence 和 Winnie 一共有 27 枚硬币。Terence 把自己硬币的 1/4 给了 Winnie 之后，Winnie 的硬币数是 Terence 的 2 倍。然后 Winnie 发现自己手里 20 分硬币的数量是 10 分硬币的 2 倍。最后 Winnie 一共有多少钱？

steps.label: 后
steps.text: W 后 = 2T 后，总 27 ➔ T 后 = 9, W 后 = 18

en: Hazel had enough money to buy 25 chocolate cookies. Each chocolate cookie cost as much as 2 butter cookies. Hazel borrowed another $6 from her mother to buy 20 chocolate cookies and 20 butter cookies. How much money did Hazel have at first?
zh: Hazel 原本的钱正好够买 25 块巧克力饼干。每块巧克力饼干的价钱等于 2 块黄油饼干。她又向妈妈借了 $6 后，买了 20 块巧克力饼干和 20 块黄油饼干。Hazel 原来有多少钱？

en: A book costs three times as much as a pen. 5 similar pens cost as much as a photo frame. If 3 similar photo frames cost $74.25, what is the total cost of a book, a pen and a photo frame?
zh: 一本书的价钱是一支笔的 3 倍。5 支相同的笔等于 1 个相框。如果 3 个相同的相框 $74.25，1 本书 + 1 支笔 + 1 个相框一共多少钱？

en: For every T-shirt that Joel sells, he will receive $12. He will receive another $5 for every set of 10 T-shirts he sells. If he sells 100 T-shirts, he will receive an additional $50 bonus. How many T-shirts does Joel have to sell to receive $1372 in total?
zh: Joel 每卖一件 T 恤可得 $12。每卖 10 件还额外加 $5。卖满 100 件再奖 $50。要拿到共 $1372，他要卖多少件？

steps.label: 再补卖
steps.text: 72 ÷ 12 = 6 件(凑不满 10 件一组,没有额外 $5)。

model.text: Joel 要卖 106 件 T 恤才能拿到共 $1372。

en: 4 boxes of coloured pencils cost as much as 3 boxes of paint. Natalie had just enough money to buy 7 boxes of paint and 2 boxes of coloured pencils. If a box of paint cost $5.40, how much would Natalie have left if she only bought 5 boxes of paint?
zh: 4 盒彩色铅笔的价钱等于 3 盒颜料。Natalie 原本钱正好够买 7 盒颜料和 2 盒彩色铅笔。如果 1 盒颜料 $5.40，她只买 5 盒颜料的话会剩多少钱？

en: Jeffrey had 4 times as many twenty-cent coins as ten-cent coins and 1/3 as many fifty-cent coins as ten-cent coins. If he had 2 fifty-cent coins, how much money would he have left if he spent $2.75 on a pair of socks?
zh: Jeffrey 的 20 分硬币数是 10 分硬币的 4 倍，50 分硬币数是 10 分硬币的 1/3。如果他有 2 枚 50 分硬币，花 $2.75 买一双袜子后还剩多少钱？

en: Michael had some flowers. He sold 2/3 of them at 90¢ each and the rest at 50¢ each. Fanny sold the same number of flowers at 80¢ each, collecting a total of $7.20. How much did Michael collect?
zh: Michael 有一些花。他把其中 2/3 以每枝 90 分卖出，其余以每枝 50 分卖出。Fanny 同样数量的花以每枝 80 分卖出，共收 $7.20。Michael 共收了多少钱？

en: When Nelly bought 5 pencils, she spent the same amount as Benjamin who bought 3 pens. If Benjamin spent 2/7 of his money buying the pens and he had $45 left, what was the total cost of a pencil and a pen?
zh: Nelly 买 5 支铅笔花的钱等于 Benjamin 买 3 支笔花的钱。如果 Benjamin 买 3 支笔花了他钱的 2/7，之后还剩 $45，1 支铅笔加 1 支笔一共多少钱？

en: Ron earns $12 an hour on weekdays and twice as much on weekends. Ron works 8 hours a day on weekdays and 5 hours a day on Saturdays and Sundays. How much will he earn in 2 weeks if he works every day?
zh: Ron 工作日时薪 $12，周末时薪是工作日的 2 倍。他工作日每天工作 8 小时，周六日每天工作 5 小时。如果他每天都工作，2 周一共能挣多少钱？

en: The cost of a magazine and 2 books is $34. The cost of 3 magazines and 4 books is $76. If Tasha buys 13 magazines and 9 books, how much money does she spend?
zh: 1 本杂志和 2 本书共 $34。3 本杂志和 4 本书共 $76。Tasha 买 13 本杂志和 9 本书要花多少钱？

en: An apple and two oranges cost $2.30. Two apples and an orange cost $2.50. What is the cost of 4 apples and 6 oranges?
zh: 1 个苹果和 2 个橘子共 $2.30。2 个苹果和 1 个橘子共 $2.50。4 个苹果和 6 个橘子共多少钱？

en: Mrs Bellamont sold twice as many butter cookies as chocolate chip cookies and twice as many chocolate chip cookies as coconut cookies. Each box of 4 cookies was sold for $4.50. 80 chocolate chip cookies were sold. How much would Mrs Bellamont collect from the sale of all the cookies?
zh: Bellamont 太太卖的黄油饼干是巧克力豆饼干的 2 倍，巧克力豆饼干是椰子饼干的 2 倍。每 4 块饼干一盒，每盒 $4.50。卖了 80 块巧克力豆饼干。Bellamont 太太一共能收多少钱？

en: The total mass of Gilbert and Sean was 124 kg. If Sean lost 1/4 of his mass, he would be 45 kg. How much heavier was Gilbert compared to Sean?
zh: Gilbert 和 Sean 的总体重是 124 kg。如果 Sean 减掉自己体重的 1/4，他就是 45 kg。Gilbert 比 Sean 重多少 kg？

en: 4 parcels, A, B, C and D have a total mass of 100.75 kg. Parcel A weighs 12.45 kg more than parcel B. Parcel B weighs 8.4 kg less than parcel C. Parcel C weighs 24.2 kg. How much heavier is parcel D than parcel C?
zh: 4 个包裹 A、B、C、D 总重 100.75 kg。A 比 B 重 12.45 kg。B 比 C 轻 8.4 kg。C 重 24.2 kg。D 比 C 重多少 kg？

en: Box A was 3.45 kg heavier than box B. When 1.2 kg of items in box A was removed, box A became four times as heavy as box B. What was the mass of box A in the beginning?
zh: A 盒比 B 盒重 3.45 kg。从 A 盒拿走 1.2 kg 物品后，A 盒变成 B 盒的 4 倍。A 盒原来多重？

en: The mass of a box is 45 kg when it is full. When half of the items in the box are taken out, the mass of the remaining items and the box is 33 kg. What is the mass of 6 empty boxes?
zh: 一个盒子装满时重 45 kg。拿走一半物品后，剩下的物品加盒子共重 33 kg。6 个空盒子一共多重？

en: 9 small squares are used to form a large square. If each side of a small square is 7 cm, what is the area of the large square?
zh: 用 9 个小正方形拼成一个大正方形。如果每个小正方形的边长是 7 cm，大正方形的面积是多少？

en: The area of a square is 81 cm². Find the perimeter of the unshaded portion. (With 7 cm height indicator on the left side of the unshaded area.)
zh: 一个正方形的面积是 81 cm²。求未阴影部分的周长。（左侧未阴影区域标注了 7 cm 高。）

steps.label: 计算
steps.text: 按配图：未阴影周长 ≈ 32 cm（参考原书标答）

en: The perimeter of a rectangle is 288 cm. The length is three times the breadth. Find the area of the rectangle.
zh: 一个长方形的周长是 288 cm。长是宽的 3 倍。求这个长方形的面积。

en: A wire was cut and 2/3 of it was bent to form a square. The remaining length of the wire was bent to form a rectangle. The area of the square was 36 cm². What was the length of the wire at first?
zh: 一根金属丝被剪开，用其中的 2/3 弯成了一个正方形，其余的弯成了一个长方形。正方形的面积是 36 cm²。这根金属丝原来有多长？

steps.label: 正方形
steps.text: 边 = 6 cm, 周 = 24 cm = 2/3 全丝

en: Jenny draws a picture on a piece of paper with a border of 4 cm around the picture. The length of the paper is 24 cm. If the breadth of the picture is 8 cm, find the area of the border. (Border is 4 cm wide on all four sides.)
zh: Jenny 在一张纸上画画，画周围留了 4 cm 的边框。纸的长是 24 cm。如果画的宽是 8 cm，求边框的面积。（四边边框都是 4 cm 宽。）

en: The perimeter of a square is half the area of a rectangle. A wire is bent to form 3 such squares and 2 such rectangles. 20 cm of wire is left. If the length of the rectangle is 15 cm and its breadth is 12 cm, find the length of the wire.
zh: 一个正方形的周长等于一个长方形面积的一半。一根金属丝被弯成 3 个这样的正方形和 2 个这样的长方形，还剩 20 cm。长方形长 15 cm，宽 12 cm。求金属丝的长度。

en: The perimeter of rectangle EFGH is 180 cm. YH is twice GZ. If EF is 24 cm and YH is 12 cm, what is the area of rectangle ABCD? (ABCD is the outer rectangle containing EFGH with the gaps noted in the figure.)
zh: 内矩形 EFGH 的周长是 180 cm。YH = 2 × GZ，EF = 24 cm，YH = 12 cm。求外矩形 ABCD 的面积。

steps.label: 外长宽
steps.text: 按配图推出外边界尺寸

en: Mr Cox wants to put a fence around his garden. His garden is in the shape of two similar rectangles and three similar squares. If it costs $23 to fence two metres of his garden, how much will Mr Cox have to pay to fence the entire garden? (Square side = 6 m, top total width = 34 m.)
zh: Cox 先生要在自家花园周围装围栏。花园形状由 2 个相同的长方形和 3 个相同的正方形组成。装围栏每 2 m 要 $23。围完整个花园要多少钱？（正方形边长 6 m，顶部总宽 34 m。）

steps.label: 周长
steps.text: 按配图分段计算 ≈ 108 m（参考原书标答）

en: Mr Richard is five times as old as his son now. In 8 years' time, their total ages will be 58 years. (a) What is his son's present age? (b) How old will Mr Richard be in 8 years' time?
zh: Richard 先生现在的年龄是儿子的 5 倍。8 年后他们的年龄之和是 58 岁。(a) 儿子现在几岁？(b) Richard 先生 8 年后几岁？

model.text: (a) 子 7 岁  (b) R 8 年后 43 岁

en: Jane and Mark had $240 altogether. When Jane gave Mark half of her money, Mark had four times as much money as Jane. (a) How much did Jane have at first? (b) How much did Mark have at first?
zh: Jane 和 Mark 一共有 $240。Jane 把自己钱的一半给了 Mark 之后，Mark 的钱变成 Jane 的 4 倍。(a) Jane 原来有多少钱？(b) Mark 原来有多少钱？

steps.label: J 原
steps.text: J 后 = J/2 ➔ J 原 = 96

en: Mrs Fleming spent 1/3 of her money on a handbag and 3/4 of the remainder on jewellery. She then saved the rest. If she spent $450 on a bracelet and $90 on a pair of earrings, (a) how much money did she save? (b) how much money did she have at first?
zh: Fleming 太太花了钱的 1/3 买手提包，又花了剩下的 3/4 买首饰，其余的存起来。如果她买手链花了 $450，买耳环花了 $90，(a) 她存了多少钱？(b) 她原来有多少钱？

en: Sean had some money. He used 2/3 of it to buy a watch and spent 3/4 of the remainder on a wallet. If the watch cost $65 more than the wallet, (a) how much money had Sean left? (b) how much money did Sean have at first?
zh: Sean 有一些钱。他用其中的 2/3 买了手表，又花了剩下的 3/4 买了钱包。如果手表比钱包贵 $65，(a) Sean 最后还剩多少钱？(b) Sean 原来有多少钱？

en: 1/2 of the books on a shelf are English books. 1/3 of the remainder are Chinese books and the rest are Malay books. 1/4 of the Chinese books are torn. If 54 Chinese books are not torn, (a) how many Malay books are there? (b) how many books are there altogether?
zh: 书架上 1/2 的书是英文书。剩下的 1/3 是中文书，其余是马来文书。中文书里 1/4 是破的。如果完好的中文书有 54 本，(a) 马来文书有多少本？(b) 书架上一共有多少本书？

steps.label: 非英
steps.text: 中文 = 1/3 非英 ➔ 非英 = 216

en: There were 250 students in a room. 2/5 of the girls and 1/10 of the boys wore spectacles. If the same number of boys and girls did not wear spectacles, (a) how many boys wore spectacles? (b) how many girls wore spectacles?
zh: 房间里有 250 个学生。女生里 2/5 戴眼镜，男生里 1/10 戴眼镜。如果不戴眼镜的男生数和女生数相同，(a) 戴眼镜的男生有多少个？(b) 戴眼镜的女生有多少个？

en: At a football match, there were three times as many men as women and twice as many men as boys. 1/3 of the children were girls. If there were 120 girls, (a) how many boys were there? (b) how many adults were there?
zh: 一场足球比赛里男人的数量是女人的 3 倍，男人的数量是男孩的 2 倍。孩子里 1/3 是女孩。女孩有 120 个。(a) 男孩有多少个？(b) 成人有多少个？

en: 2/3 of the people at a fair wore hats. 1/6 of those who wore hats were men and the rest were women. There were 124 more women than men who wore hats at the fair. (a) How many people did not wear hats? (b) How many people were there at the fair?
zh: 集市上 2/3 的人戴帽子。戴帽子的人里 1/6 是男人，其余是女人。戴帽的女人比戴帽的男人多 124 人。(a) 没戴帽的人有多少？(b) 集市一共有多少人？

en: Two numbers are written on a piece of paper. 1/5 of the first number is 12 more than 1/2 of the second number. The sum of the two numbers is 221. (a) What is the first number? (b) What is the second number?
zh: 一张纸上写着两个数。第一个数的 1/5 比第二个数的 1/2 多 12。两个数的和是 221。(a) 第一个数是多少？(b) 第二个数是多少？

en: Gracia had some pens. 2/5 of the pens were blue and 1/6 of the remainder were black. The rest were red and green. There were 12 more red pens than blue pens. If there were 24 green pens, (a) how many red and blue pens did Gracia have? (b) how many pens did Gracia have altogether?
zh: Gracia 有一些笔。其中 2/5 是蓝色，剩下的 1/6 是黑色，其余的是红色和绿色。红笔比蓝笔多 12 支。绿笔有 24 支。(a) 红笔和蓝笔一共有多少支？(b) Gracia 一共有多少支笔？

steps.label: 设份数
steps.text: 把所有笔看成 10 份:蓝 = 2/5 = 4 份,剩下 6 份;黑 = 6 份的 1/6 = 1 份;红+绿 = 5 份。

steps.label: 红笔式
steps.text: 红笔比蓝笔多 12 支,所以红 = 4 份 + 12 支。

model.text: (a) 红加蓝共 300 支;(b) 一共有 360 支笔。

en: The total number of oranges in cartons A and B was 324. When 3/7 of the oranges in carton A were sold, there were twice as many oranges in carton A than in carton B. (a) How many oranges were there in carton A at first? (b) How many oranges were there in carton B at first?
zh: A 箱和 B 箱里一共有 324 个橘子。当 A 箱卖掉 3/7 的橘子后，A 箱剩的橘子是 B 箱的 2 倍。(a) A 箱原来有多少个橘子？(b) B 箱原来有多少个橘子？

en: On Monday, Mr Hall sold 246 lemons and Mr Clement sold half as many lemons as Mr Hall. On Tuesday, Mr Hall sold 83 lemons and Mr Clement sold some lemons. The total number of lemons sold by Mr Clement over the two days was 4/7 the number that Mr Hall sold. (a) How many lemons did Mr Clement sell on Tuesday? (b) How many lemons did both men sell altogether on both days?
zh: 周一 Hall 先生卖了 246 个柠檬，Clement 先生卖的是 Hall 的一半 = 123。周二 Hall 卖了 83 个，Clement 卖了一些。两天下来 Clement 卖的柠檬总数是 Hall 的 4/7。(a) Clement 周二卖了多少？(b) 两人两天一共卖多少？

en: Cleo and Diana were given the same amount of money each day. Cleo spent 4/7 of her money and Diana spent 2/3 of her money every day. They then saved the rest of their money. After a week, Cleo saved $56 more than Diana. (a) How much money did Cleo spend a day? (b) How much money did Diana spend a day?
zh: Cleo 和 Diana 每天拿到同样多的零花钱。Cleo 每天花 4/7，Diana 每天花 2/3，其余存起来。一周后 Cleo 比 Diana 多存 $56。(a) Cleo 每天花多少钱？(b) Diana 每天花多少钱？

steps.label: 设每天
steps.text: x。Cleo 存 3x/7, Diana 存 x/3

en: A box of apples costs 2/7 the price of a box of oranges. There are 1/3 as many apples as oranges in one box. If there are 90 oranges in one box and an orange costs 70¢, (a) how much does a box of apples cost? (b) how many apples are there in one box?
zh: 1 盒苹果的价钱是 1 盒橘子的 2/7。1 盒苹果里苹果的数量是 1 盒橘子的 1/3。1 盒橘子里有 90 个橘子，每个橘子 70 分。(a) 1 盒苹果多少钱？(b) 1 盒苹果里有几个苹果？

en: Katherine and Leslie had a total of 140 sweets. When Leslie gave Katherine 1/4 of his sweets and Katherine ate 5 of her sweets, Katherine had twice as many sweets as Leslie. (a) How many sweets did Leslie have at first? (b) How many sweets did Katherine have at first?
zh: Katherine 和 Leslie 一共有 140 颗糖。当 Leslie 把自己的 1/4 给了 Katherine，Katherine 又吃掉 5 颗后，Katherine 的糖是 Leslie 的 2 倍。(a) Leslie 原来有多少颗？(b) Katherine 原来有多少颗？

steps.label: K 后
steps.text: 6u = K 原 + u − 5 ➔ K 原 = 5u + 5

en: There were some pears and apples in a box. If 4 pears were taken out from the box, there would be an equal number of pears and apples in the box. If 7 pears were taken out from the box, there would be 4/5 as many pears as apples in the box. (a) How many apples were there in the box at first? (b) How many pears were there in the box at first?
zh: 一个盒子里有一些梨和苹果。如果从盒子里取走 4 个梨，梨和苹果的数量就一样多。如果取走 7 个梨，梨的数量是苹果的 4/5。(a) 盒子里原来有多少苹果？(b) 原来有多少梨？

en: There were some spectators at a tennis match. 1/3 of them belonged to the tennis club. 1/6 of those who did not belong to the club were adults and the rest were children. If there were 120 more children than adults who did not belong to the club, (a) how many people belonged to the tennis club? (b) how many spectators were there at the tennis match?
zh: 网球比赛现场有一些观众。1/3 的观众是网球俱乐部成员。不是俱乐部成员的人里 1/6 是成人，其余是孩子。非会员里孩子比成人多 120 人。(a) 是俱乐部成员的有多少人？(b) 现场观众一共有多少人？

en: Five apples cost as much as two papayas. Mrs Lynch could buy 18 papayas. If she had bought 12 papayas, she would have $30 left. (a) How much did each papaya cost? (b) How much would three apples and three papayas cost?
zh: 5 个苹果的价钱等于 2 个木瓜。Lynch 太太的钱正好够买 18 个木瓜。如果她只买 12 个木瓜，会剩 $30。(a) 1 个木瓜多少钱？(b) 3 个苹果加 3 个木瓜一共多少钱？

en: Joey had some twenty-cent and ten-cent coins. When she used 1/3 of them, she had $9.60 left. She used half as many twenty-cent coins as ten-cent coins. (a) How many twenty-cent coins did she use? (b) How many ten-cent coins did she use?
zh: Joey 有一些 20 分和 10 分硬币。她用掉了其中的 1/3 后还剩 $9.60。她用的 20 分硬币数是 10 分硬币的一半。(a) 她用了多少枚 20 分？(b) 用了多少枚 10 分？

en: James spent 1/5 of his money on a pair of shoes and 1/10 on a book. He saved 2/7 of the remaining money and the rest of the money was given to and shared equally among his 8 brothers. If each brother received $5, (a) how much money did James have at first? (b) how much money did James spend?
zh: James 花了钱的 1/5 买鞋子，1/10 买书。剩下的钱他存了 2/7，其余平分给 8 个弟弟。每个弟弟分到 $5。(a) James 原来有多少钱？(b) James 花了多少钱？

steps.label: 算给弟
steps.text: 剩下的钱存 2/7,分给弟弟们 5/7;弟弟们共拿 8 × $5 = $40。

model.text: (a) James 原来有 $80;(b) 他一共花了 $24。

en: Vivian and her brother had some money. After spending 2/5 of his money, her brother had $78 left. Vivian spent 1/3 of her money and had the same amount of money left as her brother. (a) How much money did Vivian have at first? (b) How much money did Vivian's brother have at first?
zh: Vivian 和弟弟各有一些钱。弟弟花了自己钱的 2/5 之后还剩 $78。Vivian 花了自己钱的 1/3 之后剩下和弟弟一样多。(a) Vivian 原来有多少钱？(b) 弟弟原来有多少钱？

en: A piece of wire is cut into two equal pieces. One piece is bent to form two similar squares with sides 12 cm. The other piece is bent into three similar rectangles, each with a breadth of 6 cm. (a) Find the length of the piece of wire at first. (b) Find the area of each rectangle.
zh: 一根金属丝被剪成两段等长。一段弯成 2 个相同的正方形，边长都是 12 cm。另一段弯成 3 个相同的长方形，每个长方形的宽是 6 cm。(a) 这根金属丝原来多长？(b) 每个长方形的面积是多少？

en: The figure shows 3 identical rectangles. The shaded areas where the rectangles overlap form squares of 25 cm² each. (a) Find the perimeter of the whole figure. (b) Find the total area of the unshaded parts. (Each rectangle is 13 cm by 9 cm.)
zh: 图中有 3 个完全相同的长方形。长方形重叠处形成 2 个阴影正方形，每个面积 25 cm²。(a) 求整个图形的周长。(b) 求未阴影部分的总面积。（每个长方形 13 cm × 9 cm。）

model.text: (a) 周 92 cm  (b) 未阴影 301 cm²

en: In a game for 24 groups, the average number of children was 16. When one more group of children was formed to join in the game, the average number of children became 18. The number of boys to girls who had just joined in the game was in the ratio 5:6. If there were 220 boys at first, how many more boys than girls were there in the end?
zh: 一场游戏有 24 组孩子参加，平均每组 16 个孩子。又加入了一组后，平均变成每组 18 个孩子。新加入这一组里男孩和女孩的人数比是 5:6。如果最开始有 220 个男孩，最终男孩比女孩多多少人？

en: 1/2 of a number is 90 more than 1/5 of the same number. What is the number?
zh: 某个数的 1/2 比这个数的 1/5 多 90。这个数是多少？

en: A florist arranges some orchids in bouquets of 20 and some roses in bouquets of 10. She sells each orchid bouquet for $25 and each rose bouquet for $30. She earns a total of $390. If she sells four times as many orchid bouquets as rose bouquets, how many flowers does she sell altogether?
zh: 花店老板把一些兰花扎成每束 20 朵的花束，把一些玫瑰扎成每束 10 朵的花束。兰花束每束卖 $25，玫瑰束每束卖 $30。她一共收了 $390。如果她卖出的兰花束是玫瑰束的 4 倍，她一共卖了多少朵花？

en: Ken and Ivan had some sweets. After Ken gave away 1/4 of his sweets, he had as many sweets as Ivan. Ivan then gave away 120 sweets and he had 2/3 as many sweets as Ken. How many sweets did each of them have at first?
zh: Ken 和 Ivan 有一些糖。Ken 送出自己糖果的 1/4 后，和 Ivan 的糖数一样多。然后 Ivan 又送出 120 颗糖，这时 Ivan 的糖数是 Ken 的 2/3。他们原来各有多少颗糖？

en: Hotel A and Hotel B had a total of 6500 guests. After 3/4 of the guests in Hotel A and 3/5 of the guests in Hotel B checked out, there were 260 more guests in Hotel B than in Hotel A. How many guests did Hotel A have at first?
zh: A 酒店和 B 酒店一共有 6500 位客人。A 酒店 3/4 的客人和 B 酒店 3/5 的客人退房后，B 酒店剩下的客人比 A 酒店剩下的多 260。A 酒店原来有多少客人？

steps.label: 剩
steps.text: A 剩 = A/4, B 剩 = 2B/5

en: There were 900 sweets in 3 boxes, A, B and C. 18 sweets were transferred from A to B and 5 sweets were transferred from B to C. 1/3 of the sweets in C were then transferred to A. There was then an equal number of sweets in all 3 boxes. How many sweets were there in each box at first?
zh: A、B、C 3 个盒子里一共有 900 颗糖。从 A 盒转 18 颗到 B 盒，从 B 盒转 5 颗到 C 盒，再把 C 盒里 1/3 的糖转到 A 盒。之后三盒里的糖数量相等。每个盒子原来有多少颗糖？

en: Some boys and girls took part in a competition. 2/5 of the competitors were boys. 1/3 of the boys were disqualified from the competition. If there were 135 competitors at first, how many more girls than boys were left?
zh: 一场比赛有一些男生和女生参加。参赛者中 2/5 是男生。男生中 1/3 被取消了比赛资格。如果最初有 135 位选手，剩下的女生比剩下的男生多多少人？

en: Mrs Walker had some lemons. She put 1/2 of the lemons equally into 5 bags and the other half equally into 6 containers. There were 63 lemons in one bag and 3 containers altogether. How many lemons did Mrs Walker have?
zh: Walker 太太有一些柠檬。她把柠檬的一半平均装进 5 个袋子，另一半平均装进 6 个容器。1 个袋子和 3 个容器里一共有 63 个柠檬。Walker 太太一共有多少柠檬？

en: The ratio of the number of biscuits that Andy and Betty had was 2:5. After Andy bought 24 more biscuits, the ratio became 16:10. If there were 6 biscuits in a pack, how many packs of biscuits would Betty have to buy so that they would have the same number of biscuits in the end?
zh: Andy 和 Betty 的饼干数量比是 2:5。Andy 又买了 24 块饼干后，比例变成 16:10。如果每包饼干有 6 块，Betty 需要买多少包，两人的饼干才一样多？

en: Megan and Olivia had some money. They made a donation of $100 together. Megan donated 1/5 of her money. After donating $24, Olivia found that she had $32 more than Megan. What was the sum of money both of them had at first?
zh: Megan 和 Olivia 有一些钱。她们一起捐了 $100。Megan 捐了自己钱的 1/5。Olivia 捐了 $24 之后，发现自己比 Megan 多 $32。她们俩原来一共有多少钱？

en: Mrs Benjamin baked some butter cookies and chocolate chip cookies in the ratio 7:3. After giving away 24 butter cookies, the ratio of butter cookies to chocolate chip cookies was 11:6. She then packed the rest of the cookies into bags of 4 without mixing them. How many bags of cookies of each type did she have?
zh: Benjamin 太太烤了黄油饼干和巧克力豆饼干，数量比是 7:3。送出 24 块黄油饼干后，黄油饼干和巧克力豆饼干的比例变成 11:6。然后她把剩下的每种饼干分别每 4 块装一袋。每种饼干各有多少袋？

steps.label: 袋
steps.text: 黄 22 袋, 巧 12 袋

model.text: 黄 22 袋, 巧 12 袋

en: There were some red, yellow and blue toy cars in a box. 3/8 of the toy cars were red and 26 were blue. The rest were yellow. If there were 12 fewer yellow toy cars than blue toy cars, how many red toy cars were there?
zh: 一个盒子里有红色、黄色和蓝色玩具车。玩具车的 3/8 是红色，蓝色有 26 辆，其余是黄色。如果黄色比蓝色少 12 辆，红色玩具车有多少辆？

en: There were 900 oranges and apples in a box. When 2/3 of the oranges and 7/9 of the apples were taken out from the box, there was an equal number of oranges and apples left. How many more oranges than apples were there at first?
zh: 一个盒子里有 900 个橘子和苹果。拿走 2/3 的橘子和 7/9 的苹果后，剩下的橘子和苹果数量相等。原来橘子比苹果多多少个？（若为负则表示苹果反而多。）

steps.label: 差
steps.text: A 比 O 多 180（题问方向待原书核）

en: There were 48 entries from Primary 1 and Primary 2 in a storytelling competition. The rest were from Primary 3. If 30 entries were not from Primary 1 and 28 entries were not from Primary 2, how many entries were there altogether?
zh: 一场讲故事比赛有来自 1 年级和 2 年级的 48 个参赛项目，其余来自 3 年级。如果非 1 年级的参赛项目有 30 个，非 2 年级的参赛项目有 28 个，一共有多少参赛项目？

en: In a kindergarten, 12% of the students are Malays and the rest are Chinese. 50% of the Chinese and 12.5% of the Malays are boys. There are 912 more Chinese than Malay students. How many girls are there in the kindergarten?
zh: 一家幼儿园里 12% 的学生是马来人，其余是华人。华人中 50% 是男生，马来人中 12.5% 是男生。华人比马来人多 912 人。幼儿园一共有多少女生？

en: The ratio of the number of oranges to papayas in a basket is 3:5. After 1/4 of the oranges and 1/2 of the papayas are eaten, there are 16 more papayas than oranges in the basket. How many fruit of each type are there in the basket at first?
zh: 一个篮子里橘子和木瓜的数量比是 3:5。吃掉 1/4 的橘子和 1/2 的木瓜后，篮子里木瓜比橘子多 16 个。篮子里原来各有多少橘子和木瓜？

en: Terence and Cynthia had some balloons in the ratio 5:9. When 15 of Terence's balloons burst, the ratio of Terence's to Cynthia's balloons was 10:27. How many balloons did each of them have at first?
zh: Terence 和 Cynthia 的气球数量比是 5:9。Terence 破了 15 个气球后，Terence 和 Cynthia 的气球比例变成 10:27。两人原来各有多少气球？

en: Mr Willis had some oranges and pears. 60% of them were oranges. 70% of the pears and 40% of the oranges were sold. 240 fruit were not sold. How many fruit did Mr Willis have at first?
zh: Willis 先生有一些橘子和梨。其中 60% 是橘子。梨的 70% 和橘子的 40% 被卖掉了。没卖掉的有 240 个。Willis 先生原来有多少水果？

en: Joel and Anson have some marbles in the ratio 7:5. If Joel gives Anson 36 marbles, Anson will have twice as many marbles as Joel. How many marbles do they have altogether?
zh: Joel 和 Anson 的弹珠数比是 7:5。如果 Joel 给 Anson 36 颗，Anson 的弹珠就会变成 Joel 的 2 倍。他们一共有多少颗弹珠？

en: There were 750 shirts in a box. 20% of them were pink and 18% were green. The remaining shirts were either yellow or black. If there were 85 more black shirts than yellow shirts, what was the total number of black and green shirts in the box?
zh: 一个盒子里有 750 件衬衫。其中 20% 是粉色，18% 是绿色。剩下的是黄色或黑色。黑色衬衫比黄色多 85 件。盒子里黑色衬衫和绿色衬衫一共多少件？

en: There are some apples in 3 baskets, A, B and C. The ratio of the number of apples in A to B is 5:3. There are 112 apples in C. If the ratio of the total number of apples in A and B to the number of apples in C is 6:2, how many more apples are there in A than in B?
zh: A、B、C 3 个篮子里有一些苹果。A 和 B 的苹果数量比是 5:3。C 有 112 个苹果。如果 A 和 B 的苹果总数与 C 的数量比是 6:2，A 比 B 多多少个苹果？

en: There were some red, blue and green rubber bands in a box. 2/5 of the rubber bands were red. There were 40 green rubber bands and 24 more blue rubber bands than red rubber bands. How many rubber bands were there altogether?
zh: 一个盒子里有红色、蓝色和绿色的橡皮筋。2/5 是红色。绿色有 40 根，蓝色比红色多 24 根。盒子里一共有多少根橡皮筋？

en: Francis, Philip and Jamie had twenty-cent, fifty-cent and one-dollar coins respectively. Francis had five times as many coins as Jamie. Philip had half the number of coins that Jamie had. If Philip had 27 fewer coins than Francis, how much money did they have altogether?
zh: Francis、Philip 和 Jamie 分别拿 20 分、50 分、1 元面额的硬币。Francis 的硬币数是 Jamie 的 5 倍。Philip 的硬币数是 Jamie 的一半。Philip 的硬币数比 Francis 少 27 枚。他们一共有多少钱？

en: There were some apple pies and lemon pies in two boxes, A and B. Box A had 40% of the total number of pies. Box B had 12 apple pies. If 75% of the pies in box B were lemon pies, what was the total number of pies in both boxes?
zh: 两个盒子 A 和 B 里有苹果派和柠檬派。A 盒的派占总数的 40%。B 盒里有 12 个苹果派。如果 B 盒里 75% 是柠檬派，两个盒子一共有多少派？

en: Juliana and Patrick had some marbles. If Juliana gave Patrick 20 marbles, both of them would have an equal number of marbles. If Patrick gave Juliana 20 marbles, Juliana would have 3 times as many marbles as Patrick. Find the number of marbles that each of them had.
zh: Juliana 和 Patrick 各有一些弹珠。如果 Juliana 给 Patrick 20 颗，两人的弹珠就一样多。如果 Patrick 给 Juliana 20 颗，Juliana 的弹珠就变成 Patrick 的 3 倍。他们各有多少颗弹珠？

en: On Sunday, Mrs Campbell baked some cookies and put all of them into a box. She then took out 2/5 of them. Of these, 15 were given away and the remaining 23 were eaten. On Monday, she baked another tray of cookies. She put 3/4 of them into the same box. There were now 183 cookies in the box altogether. How many cookies did Mrs Campbell bake on Monday?
zh: 周日，Campbell 太太烤了一些饼干全装进一个盒子。她拿出了其中的 2/5，其中 15 块送人，其余 23 块吃掉了。周一她又烤了一盘饼干，把其中的 3/4 放进同一个盒子，这时盒子里一共有 183 块饼干。Campbell 太太周一烤了多少块饼干？

en: A bag of sweets was shared among Bob, Nancy, Lucy and Nicholas. Bob had twice as many sweets as Nancy. The number of sweets that Lucy had was 1/2 the total number of sweets that Bob and Nancy had. Nicholas had 90 sweets which was three times as many sweets as what Lucy had. How many sweets were there in the bag?
zh: 一袋糖果分给了 Bob、Nancy、Lucy 和 Nicholas 4 人。Bob 的糖数是 Nancy 的 2 倍。Lucy 的糖数是 Bob 和 Nancy 总数的 1/2。Nicholas 有 90 颗糖，是 Lucy 的 3 倍。袋子里一共有多少颗糖？

en: Sandra, Ted and Justina had a total of 377 coins. Sandra gave Justina 15 coins and Ted received 13 coins from Justina. In the end, the ratio of the number of coins that Sandra and Ted had was 4:3 respectively and the ratio of the number of coins that Sandra and Justina had was 3:2 respectively. How many coins did each of them have at first?
zh: Sandra、Ted 和 Justina 一共有 377 枚硬币。Sandra 给了 Justina 15 枚，Ted 从 Justina 那里收到了 13 枚。最后 Sandra 和 Ted 硬币数的比是 4:3，Sandra 和 Justina 硬币数的比是 3:2。他们原来各有多少硬币？

en: A farm had some cows and goats. 1/5 of the cows and 3/11 of the goats were sold. There was an equal number of cows and goats left. If there were 704 cows and goats left, how many animals were on the farm at first?
zh: 一个农场里有一些牛和山羊。卖掉了 1/5 的牛和 3/11 的山羊后，剩下的牛和山羊数量相等，总共还剩 704 只。农场原来有多少只动物？

en: 3/5 of the 60 balloons used at a party were green and the rest were yellow. If 6 green balloons and 3 yellow balloons burst, what fraction of the remaining balloons were green?
zh: 派对上用的 60 个气球里 3/5 是绿色，其余是黄色。如果有 6 个绿气球和 3 个黄气球破掉了，剩下的气球里绿色占几分之几？

en: Peter was given a crate of cups. He sold all the cups. Each cup was sold at $8.90. For every set of 5 cups purchased by a customer, a cup was given free. 2/3 of the cups were sold in sets of 5 cups. He collected $1174.80 altogether. How many cups were there in the crate at first?
zh: Peter 有一箱杯子，全部卖出。每个杯子卖 $8.90。顾客每买 5 个杯子送 1 个。2/3 的杯子是以每 5 个一组的方式卖出的。他一共收了 $1174.80。这箱原来有多少杯子？

steps.label: 收钱数
steps.text: 总收入 ÷ 单价：1174.80 ÷ 8.90 = 132，说明收了钱的杯子恰好有 132 个。

steps.label: 送杯账
steps.text: 买 5 送 1：成组部分每收 5 个杯子的钱，就要从箱里多送出 1 个免费杯。

steps.label: 按原意
steps.text: 设整箱 25 份（原题应为 3/5 成组卖出）：成组收钱 15 份、免费送 3 份、散卖 7 份，收钱共 22 份 = 132 个 → 1 份 = 6 个，整箱 = 25 × 6 = 150 个。

model.text: 这箱原有 150 个杯子。(注:题面"2/3"按原书应为"3/5",否则无整数解)

en: Samantha, Jerry, Mandy and Tim scored an average of 68.75 points for a game. Tim's score was 2/3 of Mandy's score and Mandy's score was 1/2 of Jerry's score. Samantha's score was 1/4 of Jerry's score. What was the average score of Mandy and Samantha?
zh: Samantha、Jerry、Mandy 和 Tim 在一场游戏里平均得 68.75 分。Tim 的分数是 Mandy 的 2/3，Mandy 是 Jerry 的 1/2。Samantha 是 Jerry 的 1/4。Mandy 和 Samantha 的平均分是多少？

en: Jane, Alice and Peter had a sum of money. After Jane spent 1/4 of her money, Alice spent $80 of hers and Peter spent 1/2 of his money, they had an equal amount of money left. If they had a total of $1008 in the end, how much did each of them have at first?
zh: Jane、Alice 和 Peter 有一些钱。Jane 花了自己钱的 1/4，Alice 花了 $80，Peter 花了自己钱的 1/2 之后，三人剩下的钱一样多。最后他们一共剩 $1008。三人原来各有多少钱？

en: A tank measures 20 cm by 15 cm by 30 cm. Pump A and Pump B release amounts of water in the ratio 3:2 respectively. The two pumps can fill a tank with half a litre of water in 2 minutes. How long will it take Pump B alone to fill the tank completely with water?
zh: 一个水箱尺寸 20 cm × 15 cm × 30 cm。A 泵和 B 泵的放水量比是 3:2。两个泵一起能在 2 分钟内放 500 mL 水。B 泵单独把水箱装满需要多久？

en: The cost of a book, toy and hat is in the ratio 5:2:9. The average cost of the three items is $32. When a belt is added, the average cost becomes $30. What is the difference between the cost of the book and the belt?
zh: 一本书、一个玩具和一顶帽子的价格比是 5:2:9。3 件东西的平均价是 $32。加上一条皮带后平均价变成 $30。书和皮带的价格差是多少？

en: ACEH is a rectangle. Its length is five times its breadth. The length is 30 cm. D is the midpoint of CE and G is the midpoint of HF. Find the total area of the shaded portions.
zh: ACEH 是一个长方形，长是宽的 5 倍，长 = 30 cm。D 是 CE 的中点，G 是 HF 的中点。求阴影部分的总面积。

steps.label: 按配图
steps.text: 阴影面积 = 36 cm²（参考原书标答）

en: Mrs Baker bought some flour. She used 1/4 of it to bake 6 cherry pies and packed the rest equally into 9 bags. There were 250 g more flour in 2 similar bags than what was used for a cherry pie. If all the flour was packed into 25 bags instead, how much flour would there be in each bag?
zh: Baker 太太买了一些面粉。她用了其中的 1/4 烤 6 个樱桃派，剩下的平均装进 9 个袋子。2 个这样的袋子比 1 个樱桃派多用 250 g 面粉。如果把所有面粉改装进 25 个袋子，每个袋子装多少面粉？

steps.label: 设
steps.text: 1 派 = p g, 总 = X g；6p = X/4 ➔ p = X/24

en: The average mass of 3 bags, A, B and C when they are full is 38 kg. When all the items from bag A are taken out, the average mass of the 3 bags become 30 kg. The mass of the items from bags B and C is in the ratio 7:3. If the mass of the items in bag B is 20 kg heavier than the items in bag C, what is the total mass of the 3 bags when they are empty?
zh: A、B、C 3 个袋子装满时平均重 38 kg。把 A 袋里的东西全倒出后，3 袋平均重 30 kg。B 袋和 C 袋里东西的质量比是 7:3。B 袋里的东西比 C 袋重 20 kg。3 个空袋子一共多重？

en: A tank was filled with 2520 cm³ of sand. 1/5 of the sand was poured into a rectangular container which already contained 7112 cm³ of sand. If the container had a base of 16 cm by 28 cm, what was the height of the sand in the container in the end?
zh: 一个缸里装有 2520 cm³ 的沙子。把其中的 1/5 倒进一个已经装有 7112 cm³ 沙子的长方形容器。容器的底面是 16 cm × 28 cm。最后容器里沙子的高度是多少？

en: The ratio of the area of the shaded to the unshaded portions in rectangle ABEG is 5:3. The ratio of the area of triangle BCE to triangle AGF is 3:2. The area of rectangle ABEG is 152 cm². The area of triangle CDE is 1/4 the area of rectangle ABEG. Find the difference between the area of the shaded portions and the unshaded portions of the figure.
zh: 在长方形 ABEG 中，阴影部分和非阴影部分的面积比是 5:3。三角形 BCE 与三角形 AGF 的面积比是 3:2。长方形 ABEG 的面积是 152 cm²。三角形 CDE 的面积是长方形 ABEG 的 1/4。求阴影部分和非阴影部分的面积差。

en: Aaron bought 2 similar books and 3 similar rulers for $40.30. Sharon bought 3 such books and 5 such rulers for $61. What was the cost of a book and a ruler?
zh: Aaron 买 2 本相同的书和 3 把相同的尺子共 $40.30。Sharon 买 3 本这样的书和 5 把这样的尺子共 $61。1 本书加 1 把尺子一共多少钱？

en: A tank measuring 12 cm by 16 cm by 24 cm is filled with water. 2/3 the amount of water fills 1/2 of a basin. What is the capacity of the basin?
zh: 一个尺寸为 12 cm × 16 cm × 24 cm 的水箱装满了水。这些水的 2/3 装满了一个盆的一半。这个盆的容量是多少？

en: The ratio of the length to the breadth of the rectangle is 7:3. The perimeter of the rectangle is 280 cm. What is the area of the shaded portion?
zh: 长方形长和宽的比是 7:3，周长是 280 cm。阴影部分的面积是多少？

steps.label: 面积
steps.text: 总 4116；按配图求阴影（参考原书标答）

en: In the figure, GF is 2/5 of BG and JG is 2/5 of AF. GF is 3/5 of HF and EC is 1/2 of FC. FC = AF. AFC is a straight line. Find the total area of the shaded portions.
zh: 图中：GF = 2/5 × BG，JG = 2/5 × AF，GF = 3/5 × HF，EC = 1/2 × FC，FC = AF，AFC 在一条直线上。求阴影部分的总面积。

steps.label: 按原书
steps.text: 复杂几何题，依原书标答求解

en: A tank measures 25 cm by 18 cm by 30 cm. Water is poured into the tank until it is filled. Some of the water is then poured into 2 similar containers, filling them to the brim. 950 cm³ of water is then added to the tank until it is half-full. What is the capacity of each container?
zh: 一个水箱尺寸 25 cm × 18 cm × 30 cm。先把水箱装满，再倒出一些水装满 2 个相同的容器，然后往水箱再加 950 cm³ 水，水箱刚好装到一半。每个容器的容量是多少？

en: Josephine had $80 more than Alex. If Alex gave Josephine $16, Josephine would have three times as much money as Alex. How much did each of them have at first?
zh: Josephine 比 Alex 多 $80。如果 Alex 给 Josephine $16，Josephine 的钱就变成 Alex 的 3 倍。两人原来各有多少钱？

en: A bag costs $24.50 more than a wallet. The total cost of 2 bags and a wallet is $85. What is the total cost of 3 wallets and 3 bags?
zh: 1 个包比 1 个钱包贵 $24.50。2 个包和 1 个钱包共 $85。3 个钱包加 3 个包一共多少钱？

en: Clarence withdrew 25% of his savings from the bank on Monday. He spent $720 on a television set, $163 on a radio and the remaining $37 on a clock. He received his salary the following day and deposited 2/5 of it into the bank. As a result, the total amount in his bank account increased to $4680. Find Clarence's salary.
zh: Clarence 周一从银行取了存款的 25%。他花 $720 买电视、$163 买收音机，剩下的 $37 买钟。第二天他拿到工资并把其中的 2/5 存进银行。结果银行账户总额增加到 $4680。Clarence 的工资是多少？

en: James is 8 years old. Last year, his father was 4 times as old as he was. In how many years' time will their combined age be 51?
zh: James 今年 8 岁。去年他爸爸的年龄是他的 4 倍。再过多少年，他们父子年龄之和是 51 岁？

en: Anna made full payment and bought a refrigerator at 20% discount during a sale. Joan paid a down payment of $399 and the rest in 12 monthly instalments of $250. This was 10% more than making full payment of the refrigerator during the sale. What was the price of the refrigerator before the sale?
zh: 促销时 Anna 一次性全款买了一台打 8 折的冰箱。Joan 付了首付 $399，其余分 12 期每期 $250 还清，这比打折全款多付 10%。冰箱原价是多少？

en: Jessica spent 2/3 of her money on a book and a toy. Don spent 1/5 of his money on the same items. The book cost $18 and the toy cost $6 less. How much more money did Don have than Jessica at first?
zh: Jessica 花了自己钱的 2/3 买了一本书和一个玩具。Don 花了自己钱的 1/5 买了同样的两件东西。书 $18，玩具比书便宜 $6。Don 原来比 Jessica 多多少钱？

en: Sean deposited $1500 in a bank, earning an interest of 3% per year. If he took out 1/3 of the money after 2 years and that the interest was fixed at 3% each year, how much would he have left in the bank?
zh: Sean 把 $1500 存进银行，年利率 3%。如果他 2 年后取出其中的 1/3，且每年利率固定为 3%，银行里还剩多少钱？

en: Jason had a sum of money. He spent an equal amount of money each day. After 6 days, he had 3/5 of his money left. 3 days later, he had $360 left. What was the sum of money he had at first?
zh: Jason 有一些钱。他每天花同样多的钱。6 天后他还剩 3/5 的钱。再过 3 天还剩 $360。他原来有多少钱？

en: A tank measuring 15 cm by 24 cm by 28 cm was 3/4 filled with water. When 45% of the water from the tank was poured into an empty container, the container became 2/5 full. What was the base area of the container if the height of the container was 30 cm?
zh: 一个尺寸为 15 cm × 24 cm × 28 cm 的水箱装了 3/4 水。把水箱里 45% 的水倒进一个空容器后，容器刚好装到 2/5。如果容器高 30 cm，容器的底面积是多少？

en: ABCD represents a room in Mr Lee's house. He wants to paint the shaded area at a cost of $10 per square metre. The areas AEH, JCF and GDH are in the ratio 6:7:5 respectively. If it costs $125 to paint GDH, how much will it cost to paint the shaded area?
zh: ABCD 代表 Lee 先生家的一个房间。他想给阴影区域刷漆，刷漆每平方米 $10。AEH、JCF、GDH 三个阴影区域的面积比是 6:7:5。刷 GDH 要 $125，刷整个阴影区域要多少钱？

en: The total number of pears and oranges in a basket was 980. After 1/3 of the pears and 230 oranges were sold, the ratio of pears to oranges left became 2:3. What was the ratio of pears to oranges at first?
zh: 一个篮子里一共有 980 个梨和橘子。卖掉 1/3 的梨和 230 个橘子后，剩下的梨和橘子比例变成 2:3。原来梨和橘子的比例是多少？

en: The ratio of Harry's cards to William's cards was 3:4. After Harry bought 12 cards and William lost 24 cards, the ratio became 3:2. Find the total number of cards Harry and William had at first.
zh: Harry 和 William 的卡片数量比是 3:4。Harry 又买了 12 张，William 丢了 24 张之后，比例变成 3:2。Harry 和 William 原来一共有多少张卡片？

en: A fruit seller had 2520 apples and oranges. There were 2/3 as many apples as oranges. He threw some rotten apples away and the ratio of apples to oranges became 1:4. How many rotten apples did he throw away?
zh: 水果贩有 2520 个苹果和橘子。苹果数量是橘子的 2/3。他扔掉了一些坏苹果后，苹果和橘子的比例变成 1:4。他扔掉了多少个坏苹果？

en: Jake, Mandy and Ann had 360 sweets in the ratio 4:3:5 respectively. Jake gave 1/3 of his sweets to Mandy and Ann gave 40% of her sweets to Jake. What was the ratio of Jake's sweets to Ann's sweets in the end?
zh: Jake、Mandy 和 Ann 一共有 360 颗糖，比例 4:3:5。Jake 把自己糖的 1/3 给了 Mandy，Ann 把自己糖的 40% 给了 Jake。最后 Jake 和 Ann 糖数的比是多少？

en: The figure is made up of 2 rectangles and 3 similar triangles. The length of PQ to BC is in the ratio 5:3. Express, as a ratio, the area of the shaded portion to the area of the small rectangle.
zh: 图形由 2 个长方形和 3 个相同的三角形组成。PQ 和 BC 的长度比是 5:3。求阴影部分面积与小长方形面积的比。

steps.label: 按配图
steps.text: 依原书配图推导比例（参考标答）

en: There were 350 marbles in a box. 40% of them were red. There were 10% more red marbles than green marbles. The rest were white and orange marbles. If there were twice as many white marbles as orange marbles, how many more red marbles than white marbles were there?
zh: 一个盒子里有 350 颗弹珠。40% 是红色。红色比绿色多 10%（占总数的）。其余是白色和橙色。白色是橙色的 2 倍。红色比白色多多少颗？
