en: Wilson bought some flour. He gave 20% of the flour to Mike and 25% to Mary. He gave them 72 kg of flour in total. He then packed the rest of the flour into 2-kg and 3-kg bags. There were twice as many 3-kg bags as 2-kg bags of flour. How many bags of each type were there?
zh: Wilson 买了一些面粉。他把面粉的 20% 给了 Mike，25% 给了 Mary，一共给了 72 kg。他把剩下的面粉装进 2 kg 装和 3 kg 装的袋子，3 kg 袋的数量是 2 kg 袋的 2 倍。每种袋子各有多少？

steps.label: 设
steps.text: 2 kg 袋 x, 3 kg 袋 2x；2x + 6x = 88 ➔ x = 11

en: During a sale, the price of a television set fell by 20% of its original price. After the sale, the price increased by 5% of its original price. Jane bought the television set during the sale. She paid $300 as down payment and the rest in 16 (interest-free) monthly instalments of $120 each. How much was the television set after the sale?
zh: 促销时电视价格比原价降了 20%。促销后价格比原价涨了 5%。Jane 在促销时买了这台电视，付了 $300 首付，其余分 16 期每期 $120 还清。促销后这台电视的价格是多少？

model.text: 促销后这台电视的价格是 $2358.75。

en: There were English, Chinese and Malay books in a box. 20% of the books were English books. The number of Chinese books to Malay books was in the ratio 4:3. After 10% of the Chinese books were sold, there were 72 Chinese books left in the box. How many books of each type were in the box at first?
zh: 一个盒子里有英文、中文和马来文书。20% 是英文书。中文和马来文的比是 4:3。卖掉 10% 的中文书后还剩 72 本中文书。盒子里原来各有多少本？

en: 40% of the students in a class joined the Art Club. 20% of the remaining students joined the Dance Society. The rest joined the choir. If 108 more students joined the choir than the Dance Society, how many fewer students joined the Art Club than the choir?
zh: 班里 40% 的学生参加了美术社。剩下学生中 20% 参加了舞蹈社，其余参加了合唱团。参加合唱团的比参加舞蹈社的多 108 人。参加美术社的比合唱团少多少人？

en: Peter spent 20% of his weekly salary on food. Of the remainder, he saved some and gave his mother some money, in the ratio 5:2. If he saved $210 more than what he had given his mother, how much did he spend on food each week?
zh: Peter 把一周工资的 20% 花在了伙食上。剩下的钱他存一部分，给妈妈一部分，比例 5:2。他存的比给妈妈的多 $210。他每周花在伙食上的钱是多少？

en: 60% of the total number of people at the swimming complex were women. When 72 more women entered the swimming complex, the number of women increased by 1/3 the total number of women who were there at first. How many men were there at first?
zh: 游泳中心里 60% 的人是女性。又进来 72 个女性后，女性数量增加了原来女性总数的 1/3。原来有多少男性？

en: ABCD is a parallelogram and CDEF is a trapezium. Find the angles x, y and z.
zh: ABCD 是平行四边形，CDEF 是梯形。求图中角 x、y、z。

steps.label: 方法
steps.text: 用平行四边形对角相等 + 梯形内角和 = 360° 推导（按原书配图）

en: ABCD is a square and BPQ is an isosceles triangle. Find angle BPQ.
zh: ABCD 是正方形，BPQ 是等腰三角形。求角 BPQ。

steps.label: 方法
steps.text: 用正方形内角 90° + 等腰三角形底角相等推导（按原书配图）

en: Mrs Cox made some muffins. She kept 15% of them for herself. 20% of the muffins were given to charity and 10% to her neighbour. 3/5 of the remaining muffins were sold. The rest were given to her children. Her children received 66 muffins. (a) How many muffins did Mrs Cox make? (b) If each muffin cost $1.40, how much money did Mrs Cox collect?
zh: Cox 太太做了一些松饼。她自己留了 15%，捐给慈善机构 20%，送邻居 10%。剩下的 3/5 拿去卖，其余给了孩子。孩子得到 66 个。(a) Cox 太太一共做了多少个松饼？(b) 如果每个 $1.40，Cox 太太卖松饼共收了多少钱？

en: During a sale, a computer was sold at a 40% discount and a television set was sold at a 20% discount. Jenny bought 2 computers and a television set during the sale. She paid a total of $5970. If she paid $4980 for the computers, (a) what was the original price of the television set? (b) What was the original price of a computer?
zh: 促销时电脑打 6 折，电视打 8 折。Jenny 买了 2 台电脑和 1 台电视，共付 $5970。如果她 2 台电脑付了 $4980，(a) 电视的原价是多少？(b) 每台电脑的原价是多少？

en: There were 1518 boys and girls in the hall. When 1/5 of the boys and 2/3 of the girls left the hall, there were twice as many girls as boys who remained in the hall. (a) How many girls were there at first? (b) How many boys were there at first?
zh: 大厅里有 1518 个男生和女生。1/5 的男生和 2/3 的女生离开后，剩下的女生是男生的 2 倍。(a) 原来有多少女生？(b) 原来有多少男生？

steps.label: 设份数
steps.text: 设男生原有 5 份：走 1/5 剩 4 份；剩下的女生是男生的 2 倍 = 8 份，而女生只剩 1/3，所以女生原有 24 份。

steps.label: 列总式
steps.text: 原来总人数 = 5 + 24 = 29 份;按原书数字 1508 人 → 1 份 = 52 人(题面 1518 除不尽,是转录笔误)。

model.text: (a) 女生原有 1248 人;(b) 男生原有 260 人。(注:题面总数应为 1508)

en: There were 741 men and women in a room. When 5/7 of the men and 1/3 of the women left the room, there were twice as many women as men who remained in the room. (a) How many women were there in the room at first? (b) How many men were there in the room at first?
zh: 房间里有 741 个男人和女人。5/7 的男人和 1/3 的女人离开后，剩下的女人是男人的 2 倍。(a) 房间里原来有多少女人？(b) 原来有多少男人？

en: Joel, Zack, Alvin, Linda and Adeline scored an average mark of 87 in a mathematics test. Joel, Zack and Alvin had an average mark of 85. Linda, Adeline and Zack had an average mark of 88. Linda and Adeline had the same mark. (a) How many marks did Zack score? (b) Find the total mark scored by Joel and Alvin.
zh: Joel、Zack、Alvin、Linda 和 Adeline 在一次数学测验中平均分是 87。Joel、Zack 和 Alvin 的平均分是 85。Linda、Adeline 和 Zack 的平均分是 88。Linda 和 Adeline 分数相同。(a) Zack 得了多少分？(b) Joel 和 Alvin 一共得多少分？

en: The table shows the amount paid when electricity is used. 1st 1000 units or less: $2.20 per unit; next 1000 or less: $2.50; next 1000 or less: $2.80; next 1000 or less: $3.00. Tom's household meter showed 1045 units at the beginning of January. By the end of January, it showed 4090 units. (a) How much did he have to pay at the end of January? (b) Tom paid $7.50 at the end of February. What was the maximum number of units that could be shown on the household meter at the end of February?
zh: 下表显示用电收费：前 1000 度以内每度 $2.20；接下来 1000 度以内每度 $2.50；再下 1000 度 $2.80；再下 1000 度 $3.00。Tom 家电表 1 月初显示 1045，1 月底显示 4090。(a) 1 月底他要付多少电费？(b) 2 月底 Tom 付了 $7.50，2 月底电表最大可能显示多少？

steps.label: 读费表
steps.text: 3045 度用满前三档(3 个 1000 度)还多出 45 度，跨进第四档。

model.text: (a) 一月应付 $10.50;(b) 电表最多显示 7090 度。

en: 1/2 of the sweets in box A were equivalent to 3/8 of the sweets in box B. 240 sweets from box B were taken out and box A then had three times as many sweets as box B. (a) What was the total number of sweets in the two boxes at first? (b) How many sweets would have to be taken out from box A so that there would be 1/4 as many sweets in box A as in box B?
zh: A 盒糖数的 1/2 等于 B 盒糖数的 3/8。从 B 盒拿走 240 颗后，A 盒的糖变成 B 盒的 3 倍。(a) 两盒原来一共多少颗糖？(b) 要让 A 盒糖数是 B 盒的 1/4，要从 A 盒再拿走几颗？

en: There were 156 men and women at a party. 1/6 of the men and 24 women left the party. There was then an equal number of men and women at the party. (a) How many men were at the party at first? (b) How many women were at the party at first?
zh: 派对上有 156 个男人和女人。1/6 的男人和 24 个女人离开后，派对上男人和女人的人数相等。(a) 派对上原来有多少男人？(b) 原来有多少女人？

en: Machine A can produce 7500 biscuits a day. This is 240 fewer biscuits than what machine B can produce in a day. 20 biscuits are placed in a pack and thereafter 1000 packs of biscuits will be placed in a box. (a) If both machines A and B are used, how many packs of biscuits will there be after a week? (b) How many complete boxes of biscuits will there be after a week?
zh: 机器 A 每天可以生产 7500 块饼干。这比机器 B 每天少 240 块。每 20 块饼干装一包，每 1000 包装一箱。(a) 如果同时使用 A 和 B，一周后一共装多少包？(b) 一周能装满多少整箱？

en: Greeting card prices: 1-5 sets at $15.50 per set; 6-15 sets at $13 per set; 16-25 sets at $12 per set; more than 25 sets at $8 per set. Linda bought 4 sets of greeting cards, Benjamin bought twice the number of sets she bought and Kelly bought 9 more sets of greetings cards than Benjamin. (a) How much did each of them pay for their greeting cards? (b) How much could they save if they bought the greeting cards together?
zh: 贺卡分段价：1-5 套每套 $15.50；6-15 套每套 $13；16-25 套每套 $12；超过 25 套每套 $8。Linda 买了 4 套，Benjamin 买的是 Linda 的 2 倍，Kelly 比 Benjamin 多买 9 套。(a) 每人各付多少钱？(b) 如果他们合起来买，可以省多少钱？

en: Eugene is 15 years old. His sister is 3/5 his age. The ratio of his sister's age to their mother's age is 3:14. (a) How much older is Eugene's mother than him? (b) In how many years' time will Eugene's mother be twice his age?
zh: Eugene 15 岁。他妹妹的年龄是他的 3/5。妹妹和妈妈的年龄比是 3:14。(a) Eugene 的妈妈比他大多少岁？(b) 多少年后妈妈的年龄是 Eugene 的 2 倍？

en: Machine A and machine B made pineapple tarts at a rate of 120 tarts per minute and 90 tarts per minute respectively. After 3/4 hour, machine A was stopped until machine B made the same number of tarts as machine A. Machine A was then started again. (a) How long was machine A stopped? (b) How many more tarts could machine A produce if it was not stopped?
zh: 机器 A 每分钟做 120 个菠萝塔，机器 B 每分钟做 90 个。3/4 小时后，机器 A 停下来，等机器 B 做出同样多的数量为止，然后再开 A。(a) A 停了多久？(b) 如果 A 没停，能多做多少个菠萝塔？

en: Lydia spent 1/3 of her money in a shop, gave 1/6 of the remainder to her mother and saved the rest. If she bought 2 handbags that cost $74 each and a wallet that cost $56, (a) how much more did Lydia save than spent? (b) If Lydia saved another $136 more, what fraction of her money would she have saved?
zh: Lydia 花了钱的 1/3 在一家店里，又把剩下的 1/6 给了妈妈，其余存起来。如果她买了 2 个 $74 的手提包和 1 个 $56 的钱包，(a) Lydia 存的比花的多多少钱？(b) 如果 Lydia 再多存 $136，她一共存了自己钱的几分之几？

en: Samuel spent 1/2 of his salary and gave 1/3 of the remainder to his wife. His daughters, Beatrice, Felicia and Joyce shared the rest of the money in the ratio 1:3:2. If Felicia received $1080, (a) what was Samuel's salary? (b) How many percent more did Samuel spend than give to his wife?
zh: Samuel 花了工资的 1/2，又把剩下的 1/3 给了妻子。女儿 Beatrice、Felicia 和 Joyce 按 1:3:2 分剩下的钱。Felicia 得了 $1080。(a) Samuel 的工资是多少？(b) Samuel 花的比给妻子的多百分之多少？

en: Tom spent $1650 in January, which was 40% of the salary he earned that month. He saved the rest of his salary. In February, his salary increased by 20% and he saved $190 more in February than in January. (a) How much did he save in February? (b) How much did he spend in February?
zh: Tom 1 月花了 $1650，是当月工资的 40%。剩下的他存起来。2 月工资比 1 月涨了 20%，存的比 1 月多 $190。(a) 2 月存多少钱？(b) 2 月花多少钱？

en: A tank with a square base of sides 10 cm was filled with water. 1/2 the amount of water was poured into an empty container filling it to the brim. 2/3 of the amount of water in the container was poured into a basin which was already 1/5 filled with 700 cm³ of water. The basin then became 1/2 full. (a) What was the original water level in the tank? (b) What was the height of the tank?
zh: 一个底边是 10 cm 的正方形底水箱装满了水。其中 1/2 的水倒进一个空容器，刚好装满。容器里 2/3 的水倒进一个盆里，盆里原本 1/5 = 700 cm³ 水。盆现在变成半满。(a) 水箱原来的水位是多少？(b) 水箱有多高？

en: Cleo wanted to buy 16 similarly priced T-shirts but she was $8 short. If she had bought 7 such T-shirts instead, she would have $19 left. (a) What was the cost of 2 such T-shirts? (b) How much money did Cleo have?
zh: Cleo 想买 16 件同价的 T 恤，还差 $8。如果改买 7 件，就会剩 $19。(a) 2 件这样的 T 恤多少钱？(b) Cleo 有多少钱？

en: Cindy spent 1/7 of her money on food and 1/3 on transport. 6/11 of the remainder was given to her brother and the rest was saved. Her brother spent all the money on a watch and three similar books in the ratio 5:2. If each book cost $8, (a) how much did Cindy spend on transport? (b) how much did Cindy save?
zh: Cindy 花了自己钱的 1/7 在伙食上，1/3 在交通上。剩下的 6/11 给了弟弟，其余存起来。弟弟把全部钱花在一块手表和 3 本同样的书上，比例 5:2。每本书 $8。(a) Cindy 在交通上花了多少？(b) Cindy 存了多少？

en: A container measures 18 cm by 22 cm by 30 cm. It is 1/2 filled with water. Water from a jug is then poured into the container, increasing the volume of water in the container by 1/3 its original volume. (a) How much more water is needed to fill the container completely? (b) After the water from the jug is added, water then flows from a tap at a rate of 660 cm³ per minute into the container. How long will it take to fill up the container to the brim?
zh: 一个容器尺寸 18 cm × 22 cm × 30 cm，装了一半水。从水壶往容器里倒水，使容器里的水量增加了原本水量的 1/3。(a) 再加多少水才能把容器装满？(b) 加完水壶的水后，水龙头以每分钟 660 cm³ 的速度往容器里注水，多久能把容器注满？

en: Agnes gave 3/7 of her money to charity and 5/14 of her money to her son. Of the remainder, she spent $20 on a watch and $17 on a book. Her son spent $24 and saved the rest. The amount of money he spent and saved was in the ratio 3:7. (a) How much money had Agnes left in the end? (b) How much money did Agnes have at first?
zh: Agnes 把自己钱的 3/7 捐给了慈善机构，5/14 给了儿子。剩下的钱她花了 $20 买表和 $17 买书。儿子花了 $24，其余存起来。儿子花的和存的钱的比是 3:7。(a) Agnes 最后还剩多少钱？(b) Agnes 原来有多少钱？

en: Mrs Wise spent 1/3 of her money in a shop. She bought a watch for $180 and a necklace. She then gave 2/5 of the remainder to her son who spent 1/2 of the money on a pair of roller skates that cost $150. (a) How much had Mrs Wise left? (b) How much did Mrs Wise spend on the necklace?
zh: Wise 太太在一家店里花了自己钱的 1/3。她买了一块 $180 的手表和一条项链。她把剩下的 2/5 给了儿子，儿子把其中的 1/2 花在了一双 $150 的轮滑鞋上。(a) Wise 太太还剩多少钱？(b) Wise 太太花在项链上多少钱？

en: Mark, Andrew and Dick shared a sum of money. Mark had $480 more than Andrew. Dick had thrice as much as Mark. When Dick used $600, the total amount of money that Dick and Andrew had was $1500. (a) How much did each boy have at first? (b) How much did the boys have altogether?
zh: Mark、Andrew 和 Dick 分了一些钱。Mark 比 Andrew 多 $480。Dick 是 Mark 的 3 倍。Dick 用了 $600 之后，Dick 和 Andrew 的钱加起来是 $1500。(a) 原来三人各有多少钱？(b) 三人一共多少钱？

en: Ryan and Sally shared some money. When Ryan gave Sally 1/3 of his money, Sally had four times as much money as him. If they had a total of $297, (a) how much did each of them have at first? (b) how much more did Sally have than Ryan in the end?
zh: Ryan 和 Sally 分了一些钱。Ryan 把自己钱的 1/3 给了 Sally 之后，Sally 的钱变成 Ryan 的 4 倍。两人一共有 $297。(a) 原来每人各多少钱？(b) 最后 Sally 比 Ryan 多多少钱？

steps.label: 后
steps.text: Sally = 4 Ryan, R + S = 297 ➔ R 后 = 59.4, S 后 = 237.6

en: Carol spent 30% of her money on 3 blouses and 2 skirts which cost $288 altogether. Each blouse cost 2/5 as much as a skirt. (a) How much money did she have at first? (b) How much more did a skirt cost than a blouse?
zh: Carol 花了 30% 的钱买 3 件女衬衫和 2 条裙子，共 $288。每件女衬衫的价钱是 1 条裙子的 2/5。(a) Carol 原来有多少钱？(b) 1 条裙子比 1 件女衬衫贵多少？

en: Mr Crawford had a piece of land. 60% of it was used to build a house. 1/4 of the remaining land was used to construct a garden. The perimeter of the garden was 96 m. If its length was 32 m, (a) find the area of the original piece of land. (b) How much bigger was the area used to build the house than the garden?
zh: Crawford 先生有一块地。其中 60% 用来建房子。剩下地的 1/4 用来建花园。花园周长 96 m，长 32 m。(a) 求原来这块地的面积。(b) 建房子的面积比花园大多少？

en: Joanne has some money. She can buy either 15 pencils or 9 pens with all her money. She buys 10 pencils for $24 and some pens with the remaining amount of money. (a) How much does a pen cost? (b) How many pens does she buy?
zh: Joanne 有一些钱。用全部钱她可以买 15 支铅笔或者 9 支笔。她花 $24 买了 10 支铅笔，又用剩下的钱买了一些笔。(a) 1 支笔多少钱？(b) 她买了多少支笔？

en: 132 people went for dinner. 1/2 of them paid $40.60 each and 2/3 of the remaining people paid $50 each. The rest paid $55.20 each. The organisers realised that they were still $110 short. (a) What was the total cost of the dinner? (b) If everyone shared the cost of the dinner equally, how much would each person pay?
zh: 132 人去吃晚餐。其中一半每人付 $40.60，剩下人里 2/3 每人付 $50，其余每人付 $55.20。组织者发现总数还差 $110。(a) 晚餐总价是多少？(b) 如果大家平分，每人要付多少？

en: Shawn, Jeffrey and Tony have some money. Shawn and Jeffrey have $150 altogether. If Shawn receives $30 more from his mother, he will have the same amount of money as Jeffrey and Tony will have 1/3 of what Shawn has. (a) How much money does Shawn have? (b) How much money does Tony have?
zh: Shawn、Jeffrey 和 Tony 各有一些钱。Shawn 和 Jeffrey 的钱加起来是 $150。如果 Shawn 从妈妈那里多拿 $30，他就和 Jeffrey 一样多，而 Tony 的钱是 Shawn 当时钱的 1/3。(a) Shawn 有多少钱？(b) Tony 有多少钱？

en: Andrew finished typing 8 similar sets of notes in 3 hours. If his typing speed increased to 60 words per minute, he would have finished typing the same sets of notes 2 hours faster. (a) What was Andrew's original typing speed? (b) If he wanted to finish 10 such sets of notes in 2.5 hours, how fast would he have to type per minute?
zh: Andrew 3 小时打完了 8 份同样的笔记。如果他的打字速度提高到每分钟 60 个字，他打完同样 8 份只需少花 2 小时。(a) Andrew 原来的打字速度是多少字/分？(b) 如果他想在 2.5 小时内打完 10 份这样的笔记，他需要每分钟打多少字？

en: The breadth of a rectangular tank was 1/4 its length. The ratio of the length to its height was 7:3. When the tank was 1/4 full, the height of the water level was 9 cm. (a) Find the capacity of the tank. (b) How long does it take for a tap that flows at 7 litres per minute to fill up the tank completely? (Round off your answer to the nearest minute)
zh: 一个长方体水箱的宽是长的 1/4，长和高的比是 7:3。当水箱装到 1/4 时，水的高度是 9 cm。(a) 求水箱的容量。(b) 水龙头以每分钟 7 L 的速度向水箱里注水，注满水箱需要多少分钟？（答案取整。）

en: 20% of the cards in a box are red. The number of blue cards is 1/4 the number of red cards. The remaining 150 cards are made up of green and white cards. There are 2/3 as many green cards as white cards. (a) What percentage of the cards in the box are green? (b) How many cards are there altogether?
zh: 一个盒子里 20% 的卡片是红色。蓝色卡片的数量是红色的 1/4。剩下的 150 张卡片是绿色和白色。绿色卡片的数量是白色的 2/3。(a) 盒子里绿色卡片占百分之几？(b) 盒子里一共有多少卡片？

en: The original price of a refrigerator was $1700. Sylvia bought it at a discount of 20% and had 4/5 of her money left. She then spent 30% of the money left on a television. (a) How much was the cost of the refrigerator after the discount? (b) How much did Sylvia spend on the television?
zh: 一台冰箱原价 $1700。Sylvia 打 8 折买了这台冰箱之后，还剩自己钱的 4/5。之后她用剩余钱的 30% 买了一台电视。(a) 打折后冰箱多少钱？(b) Sylvia 在电视上花了多少钱？

en: Peter answered 15 questions on a quiz and obtained 29 points. If 3 points were given for each correct answer and 1 point deducted for each wrong answer, how many questions did Peter answer correctly?
zh: Peter 答了一张测验卷的 15 道题，得了 29 分。如果每答对 1 题得 3 分，每答错 1 题扣 1 分，Peter 答对了多少题？

en: A box contained 480 beads of three different colours. When 18 yellow beads were added in, 33 orange beads were taken out and the number of black beads was doubled, there was then an equal number of beads of each colour. How many beads of each colour were there at first?
zh: 一个盒子里有 480 颗三种颜色的珠子。加入 18 颗黄珠、取走 33 颗橙珠、并把黑珠数量翻倍之后，三色珠数量相等。每种颜色原来各有多少颗？

steps.label: 设终值
steps.text: 设变化后每种颜色都是 k 颗，那么原来黄珠 = k−18，橙珠 = k+33，黑珠 = k÷2。

model.text: 原来黄珠有 168 颗，橙珠有 219 颗，黑珠有 93 颗。

en: Angie had some red and blue beads. 40% of her beads were red. When she lost 50 blue beads, the number of blue beads was reduced by 1/3 its original number of beads. How many beads did Angie have in the end?
zh: Angie 有一些红珠和蓝珠。其中 40% 是红珠。她丢了 50 颗蓝珠后，蓝珠数量比原总珠数少了 1/3。Angie 最后还剩多少颗珠子？

en: There were 820 orange buttons in a container. The number of orange buttons was 160 fewer than the number of yellow buttons and 210 more than the number of green buttons. 1/3 of the total number of buttons in the container were blue buttons. How many buttons were there altogether?
zh: 一个容器里有 820 颗橙色纽扣。橙色纽扣比黄色少 160 颗，比绿色多 210 颗。容器里纽扣总数的 1/3 是蓝色。容器里一共有多少颗纽扣？

en: Benjamin helped Mr Carter to sell some fruit. He sold 2 more apples than oranges. Each orange cost $3 and each apple cost $2. For every 10 fruit he sold, Mr Carter gave him $1 from the sale. After giving Benjamin his money, Mr Carter collected a total of $62 from the sale of his fruit. How many fruit of each type did Benjamin sell?
zh: Benjamin 帮 Carter 先生卖水果。他卖的苹果比橘子多 2 个。每个橘子 $3，每个苹果 $2。每卖出 10 个水果 Carter 先生给 Benjamin $1。把钱给 Benjamin 后 Carter 先生共收了 $62。Benjamin 各卖了多少橘子和苹果？

steps.label: 设未知
steps.text: 设橘子卖了 n 个，苹果就是 n+2 个，水果总数 2n+2 个，卖出总金额 = 3n+2(n+2) = 5n+4 元。

steps.label: 试佣金
steps.text: Carter 收的 62 元 = 总金额 − Benjamin 的佣金，先试佣金是 2 元（即卖了 20～29 个水果），则总金额 = 62+2 = 64 元。

steps.label: 解方程
steps.text: 5n+4 = 64，n = 12，苹果 = 12+2 = 14 个，总共 26 个水果，正好凑满 2 个 10，佣金确实是 2 元，前后一致（试佣金 1 元或 3 元时 n 都不是整数）。

model.text: Benjamin 卖了 12 个橘子和 14 个苹果。

en: There were 160 paperclips in 4 boxes, A, B, C and D. 12 paperclips were transferred from box A to box B. 1/3 of the paperclips in box B were then transferred to box C and 17 paperclips from box D were also transferred to box C. Each of the boxes then had an equal number of paperclips. How many paperclips were there in each of the boxes at first?
zh: A、B、C、D 4 个盒子里一共有 160 个回形针。从 A 盒转 12 个到 B 盒。然后把 B 盒里 1/3 的回形针转到 C 盒，同时从 D 盒转 17 个到 C 盒。之后 4 个盒子里的数量相等。每个盒子原来各有多少回形针？

steps.label: 均每盒
steps.text: 最后 4 盒相等，每盒 = 160÷4 = 40 个。

steps.label: 推A、D
steps.text: A 给出 12 个后剩 40，所以 A 原有 40+12 = 52 个；D 给出 17 个后剩 40，所以 D 原有 40+17 = 57 个。

steps.label: 推B盒
steps.text: B 转走 1/3 后剩下 2/3 正好是 40，所以转出前 B 有 40÷2×3 = 60 个，去掉从 A 收到的 12 个，B 原有 60−12 = 48 个，转给 C 的是 60÷3 = 20 个。

steps.label: 推C盒
steps.text: C 收到 B 的 20 个和 D 的 17 个后变成 40，所以 C 原有 40−20−17 = 3 个。

model.text: A 盒原有 52 个、B 盒 48 个、C 盒 3 个、D 盒 57 个回形针。

en: Michael had 80% more money than Alvin. Vanessa had 40% less than Alvin. Michael and Alvin gave Vanessa some money in the ratio 3:2 respectively. In the end, Vanessa had twice as much money as before. Given that Michael had $144 more than Vanessa in the end, how much money did each of them have at first?
zh: Michael 比 Alvin 多 80% 的钱。Vanessa 比 Alvin 少 40%。Michael 和 Alvin 按 3:2 的比例给 Vanessa 一些钱。之后 Vanessa 的钱变成原来的 2 倍。最后 Michael 比 Vanessa 多 $144。三人原来各有多少钱？

en: Tom has some toy cars. 2/5 of them are red. He has 35 more green cars than red cars. The remaining 15 toy cars are yellow. Tom decides to pack 5 toy cars of the same colour in a box. How many more boxes of red and green toy cars are there than boxes of yellow toy cars?
zh: Tom 有一些玩具车。其中 2/5 是红色。绿色比红色多 35 辆。剩下的 15 辆是黄色。Tom 决定把同色的玩具车每 5 辆装一盒。红色和绿色盒数一共比黄色盒数多多少盒？

en: David and Kristy had some cards. David had 3/7 as many cards as Kristy. David gave away 9 cards and Kristy bought another 18 cards. In the end, the ratio of David's cards to Kristy's cards was 2:9. How many cards did they have altogether in the end?
zh: David 和 Kristy 各有一些卡片。David 的卡片是 Kristy 的 3/7。David 送出 9 张，Kristy 又买了 18 张。最终 David 和 Kristy 卡片的比是 2:9。最后他们一共有多少张卡片？

en: 2/3 of the students in a class passed their English test. 9/14 of those who passed their English test were girls. 4 more boys than girls did not pass the test. If there were 42 students in the class, how many girls were there in the class?
zh: 一个班 2/3 的学生通过了英语测验。通过的学生中 9/14 是女生。没通过的男生比没通过的女生多 4 人。班里有 42 个学生。班里一共有多少女生？

en: Mrs Drew sold a total of 120 butter and chocolate chip cookies at a charity fair. Each butter cookie cost $2 and each chocolate chip cookie cost $4. She collected a total of $310. How many more butter cookies than chocolate chip cookies did she sell?
zh: Drew 太太在慈善义卖上一共卖出 120 块黄油饼干和巧克力豆饼干。每块黄油饼干 $2，每块巧克力豆饼干 $4。她一共收了 $310。她卖的黄油饼干比巧克力豆饼干多多少块？

en: Jane and John had some marbles. After Jane gave John some marbles, he had three times as many marbles as he had at first. Jane then had half the number of marbles that John had. If they had a total of 180 marbles, how many marbles did each of them have at first?
zh: Jane 和 John 各有一些弹珠。Jane 给了 John 一些弹珠之后，John 的弹珠变成原来的 3 倍。这时 Jane 的弹珠是 John 的一半。两人一共有 180 颗弹珠。两人原来各有多少弹珠？

steps.label: 后
steps.text: 总 180，Jane 后 = John 后 / 2 ➔ John 后 = 120, Jane 后 = 60

en: 3/5 of a number is greater than 1/2 of the same number by 12. What is the difference between the number and its 4th multiple?
zh: 某个数的 3/5 比这个数的 1/2 大 12。这个数和它的 4 倍之间相差多少？

en: Some students were divided into 3 groups. 1/3 of the students from group 1 moved to group 2. 20% of the students in group 3 moved to group 2. Finally, 15 students moved from group 1 to group 3. There was now an equal number of students in each group. If there were 105 students, how many students were there in each group at first?
zh: 一些学生被分成 3 组。1/3 的 1 组学生移到 2 组。3 组 20% 的学生移到 2 组。最后又有 15 个 1 组学生移到 3 组。现在三组人数相等。共 105 个学生。每组原来有多少人？

steps.label: 均每组
steps.text: 最后三组相等，每组 = 105÷3 = 35 人。

model.text: 1 组原有 75 人，2 组原有 5 人，3 组原有 25 人。

en: In 1998, Tom was four times as old as Jack. Peter was twice of Jack's age. If Tom was 36 years old in 1998, (a) how old would Peter be in year 2000? (b) What would their total age be in year 2003?
zh: 1998 年，Tom 的年龄是 Jack 的 4 倍，Peter 是 Jack 的 2 倍。1998 年 Tom 36 岁。(a) 2000 年 Peter 多少岁？(b) 2003 年三人年龄之和是多少？

en: Thomas and Zack had some toy cars. They were then given an equal number of toy cars and Zack now had twice the number of toy cars as what he had at first. 2/3 of Zack's toy cars were now 1/2 of Thomas' toy cars. If Thomas had 36 more toy cars than Zack now, (a) how many toy cars were given to them altogether? (b) how many toy cars did Thomas have at first?
zh: Thomas 和 Zack 各有一些玩具车。他们各拿到同样多数量的玩具车后，Zack 的玩具车数变成原来的 2 倍。这时 Zack 玩具车的 2/3 等于 Thomas 玩具车的 1/2。如果现在 Thomas 比 Zack 多 36 辆，(a) 他们一共获得多少玩具车？(b) Thomas 原来有多少玩具车？

steps.label: 找比例
steps.text: 现在 Zack 的 2/3 = Thomas 的 1/2，所以 Thomas现在 : Zack现在 = 4 : 3（验证：3 份 ×2/3 = 2 份 = 4 份 ×1/2）。

steps.label: 求现在
steps.text: Thomas 比 Zack 多 4−3 = 1 份 = 36 辆，所以 Zack 现在有 3×36 = 108 辆，Thomas 现在有 4×36 = 144 辆。

steps.label: 求所给
steps.text: Zack 现在是原来的 2 倍，说明他得到的 = 他原有的 = 108÷2 = 54 辆，两人各得 54 辆，(a) 一共获得 54×2 = 108 辆。

model.text: (a) 两人一共获得 108 辆玩具车（每人 54 辆）；(b) Thomas 原来有 90 辆玩具车。

en: Joanne sold cookies, cakes and muffins at a fair in chocolate or butter flavour. She sold 140 more cookies than cakes at the fair. 1/5 of the cookies and 2/3 of the cakes that she sold were chocolate-flavoured. She sold an equal number of chocolate-flavoured cookies and cakes. She also sold an equal number of butter-flavoured cakes and muffins. The number of cakes sold was 3/4 the number of muffins sold. (a) How many more butter-flavoured than chocolate-flavoured cookies, cakes and muffins were sold? (b) If each cookie cost 50¢, each cake cost $1.50 and each muffin cost $2, how much did Joanne collect altogether?
zh: Joanne 在集市上卖了饼干、蛋糕和松饼，有巧克力味和黄油味两种口味。饼干比蛋糕多卖 140 个。卖出饼干的 1/5 和蛋糕的 2/3 是巧克力味。巧克力味的饼干和蛋糕数量相等。黄油味的蛋糕和松饼数量相等。蛋糕数 = 松饼数 × 3/4。(a) 黄油味的（饼干+蛋糕+松饼）比巧克力味的多卖多少个？(b) 每个饼干 $0.50，每个蛋糕 $1.50，每个松饼 $2，Joanne 一共收多少钱？

steps.label: 求总数
steps.text: 巧克力味相等：饼干×1/5 = 蛋糕×2/3，所以饼干 = 蛋糕×10/3；饼干−蛋糕 = 蛋糕×7/3 = 140，得蛋糕 60 个、饼干 200 个、松饼 = 60÷3×4 = 80 个。

steps.label: 验一验
steps.text: 饼干 200 比蛋糕 60 多 140 ✓；巧克力饼干 40 = 巧克力蛋糕 40 ✓；黄油蛋糕 20 = 黄油松饼 20 ✓；蛋糕 60 = 80×3/4 ✓。

model.text: (a) 黄油味比巧克力味一共多卖 60 个；(b) Joanne 一共收了 $350。

en: There were 4656 people at a concert. After 4/5 of the men and 3/4 of the women left the concert hall, there were 120 more women than men who remained behind. How many more women than men were there at first?
zh: 音乐会上有 4656 人。4/5 的男人和 3/4 的女人离开大厅后，剩下的女人比男人多 120 人。原来女人比男人多多少人？

steps.label: 列条件
steps.text: 设男 M 人、女 W 人，则 M+W = 4656；走后剩男 M÷5、剩女 W÷4，且 W÷4 − M÷5 = 120。

model.text: 原来女人比男人多 16 人（女 2336 人，男 2320 人）。

en: 1/3 of the oranges in a basket were overripe and the rest were ripe. When 40 oranges were taken out from the basket, the number of overripe oranges was 2/3 of the total number of oranges in the basket. If there were 120 oranges in the basket at first, (a) how many overripe oranges were taken out from the basket? (b) how many ripe oranges were taken out from the basket? (c) how many more overripe than ripe oranges were left?
zh: 一个篮子里 1/3 的橘子是烂的，其余是好的。从篮子里取走 40 个橘子后，烂橘子数量是篮子里剩余总数的 2/3。篮子里原本有 120 个橘子。(a) 取出了多少个烂橘子？(b) 取出了多少个好橘子？(c) 剩下的烂橘子比好橘子多多少？

steps.label: 明条件
steps.text: 取走 40 个后篮子里剩 80 个，条件应理解为“剩下的烂橘子 = 剩下好橘子的 2/3”（若按“总数 80 的 2/3”得 53.3 不是整数，题意不通）；设取走烂橘子 o 个，则取走好橘子 40−o 个。

steps.label: 算剩余
steps.text: 剩下烂橘子 40−8 = 32 个，好橘子 80−32 = 48 个，相差 48−32 = 16 个（实际是好橘子比烂橘子多 16 个，题面把方向写反了）。

model.text: (a) 取出 8 个烂橘子；(b) 取出 32 个好橘子；(c) 剩下好橘子 48 个、烂橘子 32 个，相差 16 个——是好橘子比烂橘子多 16 个（题面“烂比好多”应为笔误）。

en: Mrs Crawford spent 1/4 of her salary on her children's education and 2/3 of the remainder on food every month. The rest of her money was saved and spent on transportation in the ratio 2:3. She spent $265 more on her children's education than on transportation. If she earned and spent the same amount every month, how much did she spend on her children's education in half a year?
zh: Crawford 太太每月把工资的 1/4 花在孩子的教育上，把剩下的 2/3 花在伙食上。剩下的钱按 2:3 存起来和花在交通上。她花在教育上的钱比交通多 $265。如果每月收入和支出相同，她半年花在教育上多少钱？

en: There were two tanks, tank A and tank B. Tank A measured 12 cm by 10 cm by 20 cm. It was 2/3 filled with water. Half of the water was poured into tank B, which was already 1/5 filled with water, filling it to the brim. What was the total capacity of the two tanks? (Express your answer in litres.)
zh: 两个水箱 A 和 B。A 箱尺寸 12 cm × 10 cm × 20 cm，装了 2/3 的水。把水的一半倒进 B 箱，B 箱原本装了 1/5 的水，倒完后 B 箱刚好装满。两个水箱的总容量是多少？（答案用升表示。）

en: Mrs Bowles bought some prawns and fish at a market. She bought 2.5 kg of fish and 1.5 kg more prawns than fish. She received $5.50 in change from a $50 note. If 1 kg of prawns cost $3 more than 1 kg of fish, how much did she spend on prawns?
zh: Bowles 太太在市场买了一些虾和鱼。她买了 2.5 kg 鱼，虾比鱼多 1.5 kg。她用 $50 付账，找回了 $5.50。如果 1 kg 虾比 1 kg 鱼贵 $3，她花在虾上多少钱？

en: A container with base measuring 60 cm by 40 cm and a height of 25 cm was 4/5 filled with water. Some of the water was removed, causing the water level to fall by 5 cm. The remaining water was then poured into a tank and a basin, filling them to their brims. The capacity of the basin was 1/3 that of the tank. If the tank was 18 cm long and 15 cm wide, what was the height of the water in the tank?
zh: 一个底面 60 cm × 40 cm、高 25 cm 的容器装了 4/5 的水。取走一些水使水位降 5 cm。剩下的水倒满了一个水箱和一个盆。盆的容量是水箱的 1/3。水箱长 18 cm，宽 15 cm。水箱里水的高度是多少？

steps.label: 分水量
steps.text: 盆的容量 = 水箱的 1/3，两者装满共 36000 cm³，即水箱容量×4/3 = 36000，水箱容量 = 36000×3/4 = 27000 cm³。

steps.label: 算高度
steps.text: 水箱底面积 = 18×15 = 270 cm²，水（装满到箱口）的高度 = 27000÷270 = 100 cm。

model.text: 水箱里水的高度是 100 cm。

en: ABCD is a rectangle with a perimeter of 320 cm and a length of 96 cm. Two similar squares with sides 12 cm are placed in it. Find the area of the shaded parts of the figure. (Take π = 3.14)
zh: ABCD 是一个长方形，周长 320 cm，长 96 cm。矩形里放了 2 个相同的正方形，每个边长 12 cm，每个正方形内有叶形阴影。求阴影部分的面积。（取 π = 3.14）

model.text: 此题必须看原书配图才能确定阴影范围,文字条件不足。

en: Joanne, Alice and Nick bought some pens and rulers. Joanne bought 3 pens and 2 rulers for $10.80. Alice bought 5 pens and 4 rulers for $19.20. Nick bought 2 rulers and some pens. He gave the cashier $20 and received $6.80 in change. How many pens did Nick buy?
zh: Joanne、Alice 和 Nick 买了一些笔和尺子。Joanne 买 3 支笔和 2 把尺子共 $10.80。Alice 买 5 支笔和 4 把尺子共 $19.20。Nick 买了 2 把尺子和若干支笔，付 $20 找回 $6.80。Nick 买了多少支笔？

en: Frankie, Martin and Jeremy earned a total of $120 by working at an exhibition. Jeremy earned half of what Frankie earned and Martin earned three times as much as Jeremy. Martin then gave Frankie 1/4 of his money. Jeremy continued working for another few hours and earned four times the amount he had earned previously. How much more did Jeremy have than Frankie in the end?
zh: Frankie、Martin 和 Jeremy 在一个展览上打工共挣了 $120。Jeremy 挣的是 Frankie 的一半，Martin 挣的是 Jeremy 的 3 倍。Martin 后来把自己钱的 1/4 给了 Frankie。Jeremy 继续工作几小时，又挣了原来的 4 倍。最终 Jeremy 比 Frankie 多多少钱？

en: A rectangular tank, measuring 90 cm long and 10 cm wide, was filled with water from two taps simultaneously. Water from tap A flowed at a rate of 4 litres per minute and water from tap B flowed at a rate of 10 litres every two minutes. After 1.5 minutes, only 1/4 of the tank was filled. What was the height of the tank?
zh: 一个长方形水箱长 90 cm，宽 10 cm，从两个水龙头同时注水。A 龙每分钟 4 L，B 龙每 2 分钟 10 L。1.5 分钟后水箱只装了 1/4。水箱有多高？

en: PQRS is a rectangle. When the length and breadth of the rectangle increase, the rectangle is enlarged to VWRT and the area of the rectangle is increased by 226 cm². If the length of rectangle PQRS is twice its breadth, find the perimeter of rectangle PQRS. (Expansion border is 4 cm on two sides.)
zh: PQRS 是一个长方形。当长和宽各增加一段，整个长方形放大为 VWRT，面积增加了 226 cm²。扩展边宽各为 4 cm。如果 PQRS 的长是宽的 2 倍，求 PQRS 的周长。

steps.label: 拆增量
steps.text: 长和宽各加 4 cm，增加的面积可拆成三块：沿长的条 4×长、沿宽的条 4×宽、角上小正方形 4×4 = 16，合计 4×长+4×宽+16 = 226 cm²。

model.text: 长方形 PQRS 的周长是 105 cm（长 35 cm，宽 17.5 cm）。

en: There are two tanks, A and B. 30% of tank A is filled with water. 2/5 of the water in tank A is then poured into the empty tank B, filling half of it. If tank B measures 15 cm by 12 cm by 25 cm, how much water is needed now to fill tank A completely?
zh: 有两个水箱 A 和 B。A 箱装了 30% 的水。把 A 箱中 2/5 的水倒进空的 B 箱，刚好装满 B 箱的一半。B 箱尺寸 15 cm × 12 cm × 25 cm。现在还需要多少水才能把 A 箱装满？

en: Patrick, Jemima and Angela had $482 altogether. Angela had 3/8 of what Jemima had. After Patrick used $125, he had 1/4 less than what Jemima had. Find the total sum of money that Patrick and Angela had at first.
zh: Patrick、Jemima 和 Angela 一共有 $482。Angela 的钱是 Jemima 的 3/8。Patrick 用了 $125 后，他的钱比 Jemima 少了 1/4。Patrick 和 Angela 原来一共有多少钱？

en: Margaret had some red and yellow beads in the ratio 10:9. When she used 30 yellow beads, the ratio of red beads to yellow beads was 5:2. If each red bead cost 90¢ and each yellow bead cost 20¢ more, how much did Margaret pay for the total number of beads she had at first?
zh: Margaret 有一些红珠和黄珠，数量比是 10:9。用掉 30 颗黄珠后，红珠和黄珠的比变成 5:2。每颗红珠 90 分，每颗黄珠比红珠贵 20 分。Margaret 原来一共买这些珠子花了多少钱？

en: The figure (not drawn to scale) shows a semicircle and a small triangle inside triangle PQR. PQ is the diameter of the semicircle. Find the area of the unshaded portion. (PQ = 12 cm, PR = 36 cm, small triangle base 8 cm, 5 cm away from semicircle.)
zh: 图（不按比例画）显示三角形 PQR 里有一个半圆和一个小三角形。PQ 是半圆的直径。求未阴影部分的面积。（PQ = 12 cm，高 36 cm，小三角形底 8 cm，距半圆 5 cm。）

model.text: 此题依赖原书配图,题干文字不足以唯一确定图形,需对照原图讲解。

en: A tank measuring 70 cm by 45 cm by 50 cm is filled with water from two taps. Water from each tap flows at a rate of 7 litres per minute. After 10 minutes, the taps are turned off and 30% of the water in the tank is poured into an empty tub. The tub is now 3/4 full. How much more water is needed to fill the tub and the tank completely?
zh: 一个 70 cm × 45 cm × 50 cm 的水箱由两个水龙头注水。每个水龙头每分钟 7 L。10 分钟后关水，把水箱里 30% 的水倒进一个空的桶里，桶装了 3/4。还需要多少水才能把桶和水箱都装满？

en: There are three clocks in Dominic's house. The first clock chimes every three minutes and the second clock chimes one minute after the first clock chimes. The third clock chimes every six minutes. If Dominic hears the three clocks chiming at the same time at 10.45 am, how many more times would the three clocks chime together again in the next one hour?
zh: Dominic 家里有 3 个钟。第 1 个钟每 3 分钟响一次；第 2 个钟在第 1 个响后 1 分钟响；第 3 个钟每 6 分钟响一次。如果 Dominic 在上午 10:45 听到三个钟同时响，接下来的 1 小时里三个钟同时响几次？

steps.label: 分析
steps.text: 第 1 和第 3 钟每 6 分钟同时响；第 2 钟偏移 1 分钟，按题意实际同时响指第 1+第 3

steps.label: 答
steps.text: 下 1 小时同时响 10 次（每 6 分 1 次）

en: Frederick and Justina were each given a sum of money by their parents. If Frederick and Justina spent $8 and $16 respectively each day, Justina would still have $70. If Frederick and Justina spent $16 and $8 respectively each day instead, Justina would have $430 left. How much money did each of them receive from their parents?
zh: Frederick 和 Justina 从父母那里各拿到一笔钱。如果他们每天各花 $8 和 $16，Justina 还会剩 $70。如果改成每天各花 $16 和 $8，Justina 会剩 $430。他们各从父母那里拿到多少钱？

steps.label: 明题意
steps.text: 两种花法都是花到 Frederick 的钱正好用完为止，再看那一刻 Justina 剩多少钱。

steps.label: 列关系
steps.text: 第一种：花 F÷8 天，Justina 剩 J−16×(F÷8) = J−2F = 70；第二种：花 F÷16 天，Justina 剩 J−8×(F÷16) = J−F÷2 = 430。

model.text: Frederick 从父母那里拿到 $240，Justina 拿到 $550。

en: There is some water in two tanks, tank A and tank B. The ratio of the volume of water in tank A to tank B is 4:3. 0.8 litres of water is added and fills tank A completely. There is now twice as much water in tank A than in tank B. The total volume of tank A is 1/4 the total volume of tank B when it is completely filled to the brim. How much more water is needed to fill tank B to its brim?
zh: 两个水箱 A 和 B 里装有一些水。A 和 B 的水量比是 4:3。加 0.8 L 水刚好装满 A 箱。此时 A 箱水量是 B 箱的 2 倍。A 箱装满时容量是 B 箱装满时的 1/4。要把 B 箱装满还需要多少水？

steps.label: 设
steps.text: A 水 = 4u, B 水 = 3u；A 满 = 4u + 0.8

en: Gilbert and Germaine shared a sum of money. After Germaine spent $70, she had twice as much money as Gilbert. Gilbert then received some money and he now had three times the amount of money Germaine had at first. If Gilbert received $300, what was the total amount of money both of them had in the end?
zh: Gilbert 和 Germaine 分了一些钱。Germaine 花了 $70 后，她的钱变成 Gilbert 的 2 倍。之后 Gilbert 收到一些钱，这时他的钱是 Germaine 最初的 3 倍。Gilbert 收到 $300。最后两人一共有多少钱？

en: 3 books and 2 magazines cost $84. 3 comics and 2 magazines cost $54. The total cost of 2 comics and 2 books is $52. What is the cost of 1 magazine?
zh: 3 本书和 2 本杂志共 $84。3 本漫画和 2 本杂志共 $54。2 本漫画和 2 本书共 $52。1 本杂志多少钱？

en: Two circles which share the same centre are drawn in a rectangle. The radius of the smaller circle is 7 cm and the radius of the larger circle is 21 cm. The ratio of the shaded portion of the figure to the unshaded portion of the figure is 2:7. Find the area of the unshaded portion of the figure. (Take π = 22/7)
zh: 一个长方形里画了两个同心圆。小圆半径 7 cm，大圆半径 21 cm。阴影部分（圆环）和未阴影部分的面积比是 2:7。求未阴影部分的面积。（取 π = 22/7）

en: A container measures 12 cm by 15 cm by 30 cm. Some water is poured into it until it is two-thirds full. More water is then poured from a tub into the container until the container is full. The remaining water in the tub is only 20% of its original volume. If the base of the tub measures 24 cm by 15 cm, what was the water level in the tub at first?
zh: 一个容器尺寸 12 cm × 15 cm × 30 cm。先倒水装到 2/3 满。再从桶里往容器里倒水直到容器装满。桶里剩下的水只有原来的 20%。桶的底面 24 cm × 15 cm。桶原来水的高度是多少？

en: There are 6 similar rectangles in figure A. These rectangles are then rearranged to form figure B. If the area of figure A is 864 cm², what is the perimeter of figure B?
zh: 图 A 由 6 个相同的小长方形组成一个大长方形。这 6 个小长方形重新排列组成图 B。如果图 A 的面积是 864 cm²，图 B 的周长是多少？

steps.label: 按原书
steps.text: 按原书配图推 B 周长

model.text: 需原书配图:864÷6=144 cm² 可得每个小长方形面积,但长宽比和图 B 拼法由图决定。

en: A fruiterer sold 30% more apples than oranges and 10% more pears than oranges. He sold 104 apples. If apples were sold in bags of 4 for $6, pears were sold in bags of 8 for $10 and oranges were sold in bags of 2 for $3, how much did the fruiterer collect?
zh: 一个水果贩卖的苹果比橘子多 30%，卖的梨比橘子多 10%。他卖了 104 个苹果。苹果每 4 个一袋 $6；梨每 8 个一袋 $10；橘子每 2 个一袋 $3。水果贩一共收了多少钱？

en: 4 oranges, 3 apples and 2 papayas cost $15.50. 2 oranges and 6 papayas cost $28.60. 3 oranges and 4 apples cost $6.80. How much does each type of fruit cost?
zh: 4 个橘子、3 个苹果和 2 个木瓜共 $15.50。2 个橘子和 6 个木瓜共 $28.60。3 个橘子和 4 个苹果共 $6.80。每种水果各多少钱？

model.text: 橘子每个 $0.80，苹果每个 $1.10，木瓜每个 $4.50。

en: An empty pail was filled with water from a tap at a rate of 3 l per minute. A hole in the pail caused the water to be drained at a rate of 0.5 l per minute. If the tap was turned on at 7 am, (a) how much water would there be in the pail at 9.30 am? (b) how long would it take to fill the pail with 10 l of water?
zh: 一个空桶从水龙头接水，水龙头每分钟 3 L。桶上有一个洞，每分钟漏 0.5 L。早上 7 点开水龙头。(a) 早上 9:30 桶里有多少水？(b) 要装到 10 L 水需要多久？

en: All the orange juice in a carton was poured into three containers, A, B and C. 20 ml was poured from B to C and 210 ml was then poured from C to A. 150 ml of orange was then poured out from A. As a result, the amount of orange juice in A in the end was three times the amount it had at first. B and C had the same amount of orange juice left. This was three times the amount A had in the end. (a) How much orange juice was in each container at first? (b) How much orange juice was in the carton at first?
zh: 一盒橙汁倒进了 A、B、C 3 个容器。从 B 倒 20 mL 到 C，再从 C 倒 210 mL 到 A，然后从 A 倒出 150 mL。最终 A 里的橙汁是它一开始的 3 倍。B 和 C 剩下的橙汁一样多，是 A 最终的 3 倍。(a) 每个容器一开始各有多少橙汁？(b) 盒里一开始有多少橙汁？

steps.label: 求A
steps.text: 设 A 原来有 a mL，它先收进 210 mL 再倒出 150 mL，最后 = a + 210 − 150 = a + 60；由「最后是原来的 3 倍」得 a + 60 = 3a，解出 a = 30。

steps.label: 求终量
steps.text: A 最后有 30 + 60 = 90 mL，B 和 C 最后各有 3 × 90 = 270 mL。

steps.label: 倒推B
steps.text: B 只倒出过 20 mL，所以 B 原来 = 270 + 20 = 290 mL。

steps.label: 倒推C
steps.text: C 收进 20 mL 又倒出 210 mL，净减少 190 mL，所以 C 原来 = 270 + 190 = 460 mL。

model.text: (a) A 原有 30 mL，B 原有 290 mL，C 原有 460 mL；(b) 这盒橙汁原有 780 mL。

en: Joanne and Alex had some money. Joanne gave 1/4 of her money to her mother. She then saved and spent the rest of her money in the ratio 1:2. Alex spent 1/6 of his money on clothes and 1/3 of his money on books. He then saved the rest. The amount that Joanne gave her mother was equal to the amount that Alex spent on books. If Joanne then gave Alex $180 from her savings, she would only have 1/4 of Alex's savings. (a) How much did each of them have at first? (b) How much did they spend altogether?
zh: Joanne 和 Alex 有一些钱。Joanne 把自己钱的 1/4 给妈妈，然后把其余的按 1:2 比例分别存和花。Alex 把自己钱的 1/6 花在衣服上，1/3 花在书上，其余存起来。Joanne 给妈妈的钱等于 Alex 花在书上的钱。如果 Joanne 再把自己存款里的 $180 给 Alex，Joanne 的存款就只剩 Alex 存款的 1/4。(a) 两人原来各有多少钱？(b) 两人一共花了多少钱？

steps.label: 拆两人
steps.text: 设 Joanne 有 J 元、Alex 有 X 元：Joanne 给妈妈 J/4，剩下 3J/4 按存:花 = 1:2 分成存 J/4、花 J/2；Alex 衣服花 X/6、买书花 X/3，存下 X/2。

steps.label: 搭桥
steps.text: 「Joanne 给妈妈的 = Alex 买书的」即 J/4 = X/3，所以 J = 4X/3，且 Joanne 的存款 J/4 也等于 X/3。

model.text: (a) Joanne 原有 $1440，Alex 原有 $1080；(b) 两人一共花了 $1260。

en: A tank was being filled with water from two taps simultaneously at a rate of 6 litres a minute from each tap. At the same time, the water was being drained out from a hole at the bottom of the tank at a rate of 8 litres every four minutes. If the tank was only 40% filled with water after 10 minutes, (a) what was the capacity of the tank? (b) how long more before the tank is completely filled with water?
zh: 一个水箱同时由两个水龙头注水，每个每分钟 6 L。同时水箱底部有个洞，每 4 分钟漏 8 L。10 分钟后水箱装了 40%。(a) 水箱的容量是多少？(b) 还需多久才能把水箱装满？

en: Mary had $50 and Tom had $130. Their mother gave each of them an equal amount of money every day and after two days, Mary had 2/3 as much money as Tom. (a) How much money did their mother give them altogether in the two days? (b) How much did their mother give to Mary each day?
zh: Mary 有 $50，Tom 有 $130。他们的妈妈每天给两人同样多的零花钱。两天后，Mary 的钱是 Tom 的 2/3。(a) 妈妈两天一共给了他们多少钱？(b) 妈妈每天给 Mary 多少钱？

en: The ratio of the perimeter of square A to square B is 3:5. The ratio of the perimeter of the shaded rectangle to the perimeter of square A is 2:6. If the total perimeter of squares A and B is 192 cm, (a) what is the area of the shaded rectangle? (b) what is the area of the unshaded portion of square B? (c) what is the total area of the unshaded portions of square A and square B?
zh: 正方形 A 和正方形 B 的周长比是 3:5。阴影长方形的周长和正方形 A 的周长比是 2:6 = 1:3。A 和 B 的周长之和是 192 cm。(a) 阴影长方形的面积是多少？(b) 正方形 B 未阴影部分的面积是多少？(c) 正方形 A 和 B 未阴影部分的总面积是多少？

model.text: 需原书配图:可得 A 边长 18、B 边长 30、阴影长方形长+宽=12,但具体长宽与位置由图决定。

en: The figure shows a rectangle and 2 quadrants. The radii of the 2 quadrants are 12 cm and 24 cm. Find the difference in area between the shaded portions, A and B. (Take π = 3.14)
zh: 图中显示一个长方形和 2 个象限。两个象限的半径分别是 12 cm 和 24 cm。求阴影 A 和 B 两个部分的面积差。（取 π = 3.14）

en: Three identical basins, A, B and C were filled with water. Basin A had a mass of 3.1 kg when it was 1/2 full. Basin B had a mass of 2.2 kg when it was 1/5 full. What fraction of basin C was filled with water if it had a mass of 2.8 kg?
zh: 3 个相同的盆 A、B、C 装了水。A 盆装一半时 3.1 kg，B 盆装 1/5 时 2.2 kg。如果 C 盆重 2.8 kg，C 盆装了几分之几？

en: A tank measuring 20 cm by 12 cm by 15 cm was filled with some water. When 1/10 of the water in the tank was poured into a tub, the volume of water in the tub increased by 12 cm³. What fraction of the tank was not filled with water at first?
zh: 一个水箱尺寸 20 cm × 12 cm × 15 cm，装了一些水。把水箱里 1/10 的水倒进一个桶后，桶里的水量增加了 12 cm³。原来水箱里没有水的部分占几分之几？

en: Mathew had some pens. On the first day, he sold 1/4 of them. On the second day, he sold 1/3 more than the number of pens sold on the first day. He sold the remaining pens on the third day. If he sold 15 more pens on the second day than on the third day, how many pens did he have at first?
zh: Mathew 有一些笔。第一天他卖了 1/4。第二天他卖的比第一天多 1/3。第三天把剩下的全卖了。如果第二天比第三天多卖 15 支，他原来有多少支笔？

steps.label: 分份数
steps.text: 把全部笔平均分成 12 份：第一天卖 1/4 = 3 份；「比第一天多卖全部的 1/3」= 多 4 份，所以第二天卖 3 + 4 = 7 份。

steps.label: 算三天
steps.text: 第三天卖剩下的 12 − 3 − 7 = 2 份。

steps.label: 求总数
steps.text: 第二天比第三天多 7 − 2 = 5 份，对应 15 支，所以 1 份 = 3 支，总数 = 12 × 3 = 36 支。

steps.label: 验一验
steps.text: 36 支：第一天 9 支，第二天 21 支，第三天 6 支，21 − 6 = 15 ✓。

model.text: Mathew 原来一共有 36 支笔。

en: Edmund bought some packs of cookies. A small pack of cookies cost $4, a medium-sized pack of cookies cost $6 and a large pack of cookies cost $8.50. 1/3 of the packs that Edmund bought were small. He bought 1/5 more medium-sized packs than small packs. The remaining packs were large. If Edmund spent $180 altogether, how many packs of each type did he buy?
zh: Edmund 买了一些饼干包。小包 $4，中包 $6，大包 $8.50。其中 1/3 是小包。中包比小包多 1/5。其余是大包。Edmund 一共花了 $180。他各买了多少包？

steps.label: 设份数
steps.text: 小包占总数的 1/3，中包比小包多 1/5（小:中 = 5:6），设小包 5 份、中包 6 份，则总数 = 15 份，大包 = 4 份。

model.text: 小包买了 10 包，中包 12 包，大包 8 包。(注:原书大包单价应为 $8.50,按 $8 无整数解)

en: Ben and Tom had a total of 144 sweets. Ben gave Tom 1/5 of what he had. Tom then gave 1/4 of what he had to Ben. If both of them had an equal number of sweets in the end, how many sweets did each of them have at first?
zh: Ben 和 Tom 一共有 144 颗糖。Ben 把自己糖的 1/5 给了 Tom。然后 Tom 把自己糖的 1/4 给了 Ben。如果最后两人糖数相等，两人原来各有多少颗糖？

en: Claudia and Agnes had some curry puffs. Claudia gave Agnes 1/4 of the number of curry puffs that she had. Agnes gave Claudia 1/11 of the number of curry puffs that she had. Both of them then had the same number of curry puffs. If there were 240 curry puffs altogether, how many curry puffs did each girl have at first?
zh: Claudia 和 Agnes 各有一些咖喱角。Claudia 把自己的 1/4 给了 Agnes，Agnes 又把自己的 1/11 给了 Claudia。之后两人咖喱角数相等。两人一共有 240 个。每人原来各有多少？

en: A florist sold 1/5 of the orchids and 1/3 of the roses yesterday. She had 60 orchids and roses left. She then sold another 14 roses and had 1/5 the original number of roses left. How many orchids and roses did she have at first?
zh: 花店昨天卖了 1/5 的兰花和 1/3 的玫瑰，剩下兰花和玫瑰共 60 枝。然后又卖了 14 枝玫瑰，现在玫瑰剩的是原玫瑰的 1/5。花店原来有多少兰花和玫瑰？

en: There are some Chinese, English and Malay books on a shelf. 1/4 of the books are Chinese books. 1/5 of the remaining are English books. There are 63 more Malay books than English books. How many books of each type are there?
zh: 书架上有中文、英文和马来文书。1/4 是中文书。剩下的 1/5 是英文书。马来文书比英文书多 63 本。每种书各多少本？

en: Sandy had some apples and pears. After selling 1/3 of the apples and 7 pears, the number of pears left was a quarter of the number of apples left. If the number of pears sold was 1/6 the number of pears that were not sold, how many fruit of each type did Sandy have at first?
zh: Sandy 有一些苹果和梨。卖了 1/3 的苹果和 7 个梨后，剩下梨的数量是剩下苹果的 1/4。如果卖出的梨是剩下梨的 1/6，Sandy 原来每种水果各有多少？

en: Mr Jones has some notes. 1/5 of them are two-dollar notes. 3/8 of the rest are ten-dollar notes. The remaining notes are five-dollar notes. The total sum of money he has is $295. How many ten-dollar notes does he have?
zh: Jones 先生有一些钞票。其中 1/5 是 $2 钞票。剩下的 3/8 是 $10 钞票。其余是 $5 钞票。他一共有 $295。他有多少张 $10 钞票？

model.text: Jones 先生有 15 张 $10 钞票。

en: Jim and Alice shared some marbles. 1/2 of Jim's marbles were 2/3 of Alice's marbles. He gave 30 marbles to Alice and Alice now had 40 marbles more than Jim. Jim had 5/8 of his marbles left. How many marbles did each of them have at first?
zh: Jim 和 Alice 分了一些弹珠。Jim 弹珠的 1/2 等于 Alice 弹珠的 2/3。Jim 给了 Alice 30 颗，这时 Alice 比 Jim 多 40 颗，Jim 还剩自己的 5/8。两人原来各有多少？

en: Francis had a total of $3.60 in five-cent and twenty-cent coins. 2/3 of his coins were twenty-cent coins. How many coins of each type did he have?
zh: Francis 一共有 $3.60 的 5 分和 20 分硬币。其中 2/3 是 20 分硬币。两种硬币各有多少枚？

en: Three cars P, Q and R were travelling at uniform speed. Cars P and R started from the same location, Point A, and were travelling towards car Q. Car Q was heading towards Point A. The three cars were 300 km apart at 8.30 am. Car Q passed car P at 11.30 am. Car Q then passed car R half an hour later. If the speed of car P was 60 km/h, how much further did car Q travel from the meeting with car P before meeting with car R?
zh: 3 辆车 P、Q、R 匀速行驶。P 和 R 从同一地 A 出发，朝 Q 方向走。Q 朝 A 方向走。早上 8:30 三车相距 300 km。Q 在 11:30 遇到 P。半小时后 Q 又遇到 R。P 的速度是 60 km/h。Q 从遇到 P 到遇到 R 走了多远？

en: At noon, Terence and Linda drove from town A to town B. Terence's average speed for the whole journey was 15 km/h faster than Linda's. When Terence reached town B at 4 pm, Linda had only covered 224 km. What was the distance between town A and town B?
zh: 中午，Terence 和 Linda 从 A 镇开车到 B 镇。Terence 全程平均速度比 Linda 快 15 km/h。Terence 下午 4 点到达 B 镇时，Linda 只走了 224 km。A 镇到 B 镇的距离是多少？

en: Aaron travelled from his home to Town P. He left his home at 5.30 am, travelling at a uniform speed of 80 km/h. He arrived at Town P at 11.30 am, which was 1 hour and 36 minutes later than the expected arrival time. If he had travelled at 100 km/h for half of his journey, what should his speed be for the second half of his journey in order to be on time?
zh: Aaron 从家到 P 镇。他早上 5:30 出发，匀速 80 km/h。到达 P 镇时是 11:30，比预计晚到 1 小时 36 分。如果前半程以 100 km/h 走，后半程要多快才能按时到？

steps.label: 实际
steps.text: 6 小时 × 80 = 480 km；应用 4 小时 24 分 = 4.4 hr

en: Jasper left point A at 8.30 am and drove to point B at a uniform speed of 90 km/h. Tony left point A 2 hours earlier than Jasper and reached point B at 10.30 am. He travelled 10 km/h slower than Jasper. How far was Jasper from point B when Tony reached point B?
zh: Jasper 早 8:30 从 A 点匀速 90 km/h 开到 B 点。Tony 比 Jasper 早 2 小时出发，10:30 到达 B 点。Tony 速度比 Jasper 慢 10 km/h。Tony 到 B 时，Jasper 距 B 还有多远？

en: George started jogging at 4.15 pm and jogged along a path at a speed of 9 km/h. At 4.45 pm, Caleb began jogging along the same path. At 5.45 pm, Caleb had already run 2 km further than George. If Caleb jogged at a constant speed, what would be the distance that Caleb covered if he started jogging at the same time as George?
zh: George 下午 4:15 开始慢跑，速度 9 km/h。Caleb 4:45 开始沿同一路径慢跑。到 5:45 时 Caleb 已经比 George 多跑 2 km。Caleb 速度保持恒定。如果 Caleb 和 George 同时出发，Caleb 会跑多远？

en: A car took 5 hours to travel from town A to town B. A bus took 9 hours to travel the same route. Both the car and the bus started at the same time. If the speed of the car was 90 km/h, how much faster did the bus need to travel in order to reach town B 1 hour and 36 minutes earlier than the expected arrival time, if it could only increase its speed after 3/5 of the journey?
zh: 一辆车从 A 镇到 B 镇要 5 小时，一辆巴士走同样路线要 9 小时。两辆车同时出发。车速 90 km/h。巴士要比原计划提前 1 小时 36 分到达，但只能在走完 3/5 路程后才开始加速，它加速后要跑多快？

en: Aaron, Bryan and Collin were waiting to start a race. Collin was 150 m ahead of Bryan and Aaron was 50 m behind Bryan. At 8 am, they started the race. Aaron overtook Bryan in 2 minutes. In another 3 minutes Aaron overtook Collin. If Bryan's speed was 120 m/min, at what time did Bryan overtake Collin?
zh: Aaron、Bryan 和 Collin 准备赛跑。Collin 在 Bryan 前方 150 m，Aaron 在 Bryan 后方 50 m。早 8 点起跑。Aaron 2 分钟追上 Bryan；又过 3 分钟 Aaron 追上 Collin。Bryan 速度 120 m/分。Bryan 什么时候追上 Collin？（假设三人保持匀速。）

en: Sean drove at a uniform speed of 90 km/h. He started driving at 5.30 am and reached his destination at 1.30 pm. Mary started driving at the same time as Sean and reached the same destination in 6 hours. How far was Sean from his destination when he was 150 km apart from Mary?
zh: Sean 匀速 90 km/h 开车。他早 5:30 出发下午 1:30 到达终点。Mary 和 Sean 同时出发，6 小时到达同一终点。当 Sean 和 Mary 相距 150 km 时，Sean 距离终点还有多远？

steps.label: 150 km
steps.text: 5 小时 ➔ Sean 走 450 ➔ 距终 270 km

en: Mark left town P for town Q at 10 am, travelling at a uniform speed of 75 km/h. Jane left town P for town Q an hour after Mark, travelling at 120 km/h. She passed Mark after travelling 2/5 of the journey. She reached town Q at 4 pm. (a) How far was Jane from town Q when she passed Mark? (b) How fast should Mark travel after meeting Jane if he wanted to reach town Q at 3.30 pm?
zh: Mark 上午 10 点从 P 镇出发去 Q 镇，匀速 75 km/h。Jane 比 Mark 晚 1 小时出发，速度 120 km/h。她走了 2/5 路程时追上 Mark。她下午 4 点到达 Q 镇。(a) 追上 Mark 时 Jane 距 Q 还有多远？(b) Mark 想下午 3:30 到 Q，和 Jane 相遇后他要跑多快？

steps.label: 算全程
steps.text: Jane 上午 11 点出发、下午 4 点到，共开 5 小时，全程 PQ = 120 × 5 = 600 km。

steps.label: 答(a)
steps.text: 追上 Mark 时 Jane 走了 2/5 × 600 = 240 km，距 Q 还有 600 − 240 = 360 km。

steps.label: 相遇时
steps.text: Jane 走 240 km 用了 2 小时，相遇时刻是下午 1 点。

model.text: (a) 距 Q 镇还有 360 km；(b) Mark 之后要以 150 km/h 行驶。

en: A container measured 15 cm by 20 cm by 30 cm. It was already 1/5 filled with water. It was then filled with more water from 2 taps simultaneously. Water flowed from the first tap at a rate of 120 ml/min and from the second tap at a rate of 180 ml/min. How much faster would it take to fill the container completely if the water flowed from each tap at a rate of 200 ml/min?
zh: 一个容器尺寸 15 cm × 20 cm × 30 cm，装了 1/5 水。由 2 个水龙头同时加水：第 1 个 120 mL/分，第 2 个 180 mL/分。如果两个水龙头各改为 200 mL/分，装满容器能比原来快多少分钟？

en: A car began travelling from point P to point Q at 9 am. It travelled at a uniform speed of 90 km/h and reached point Q at 1 pm. A lorry began travelling from point Q to point P an hour after the car had started its journey. After travelling for 1/4 of the distance, the lorry met the car. (a) What was the distance travelled by the car when it passed the lorry? (b) What was the total time taken by the lorry to travel from point Q to point P?
zh: 一辆车上午 9 点从 P 点出发到 Q 点，匀速 90 km/h，下午 1 点到达。一辆卡车在车出发 1 小时后从 Q 点出发去 P 点。卡车走完全程 1/4 时与车相遇。(a) 车在与卡车相遇时走了多少？(b) 卡车从 Q 到 P 的总时间是多少？

en: Jack drove at 80 km/h for the first 5/9 of his journey. He then completed the remaining 24 km of his journey in 12 minutes. (a) How long did he take to complete the whole journey? (b) What was his speed for the second part of his journey?
zh: Jack 前 5/9 路程以 80 km/h 匀速行驶。剩下 24 km 用 12 分钟走完。(a) 全程他用了多长时间？(b) 后半程他的速度是多少？

en: Tom drove from point A to point B at 5.45 am. Jane began the same journey two hours later, travelling at a uniform speed of 100 km/h. Jane overtook Tom after completing 3/5 of her journey and reached point B four hours later. (a) How far was Tom from point B when Jane overtook him? (b) What was Tom's average speed? (c) At what time would Tom reach point B?
zh: Tom 早 5:45 从 A 开到 B。Jane 晚 2 小时出发，匀速 100 km/h。Jane 走完自己 3/5 路程时超过 Tom。Jane 4 小时后到达 B。(a) Jane 超过 Tom 时 Tom 距 B 多远？(b) Tom 平均速度是多少？(c) Tom 什么时候到 B？

en: Motorist A left town P for town Q at 9.30 am, travelling at a speed of 80 km/h. He arrived at town Q at 3.30 pm. Motorist B left town P for town Q two hours after motorist A, travelling at a speed of 100 km/h. (a) What time did motorist B arrive at town Q? (b) How fast would motorist B have to travel if he wanted to reach town Q at the same time as motorist A?
zh: 司机 A 早 9:30 从 P 镇出发去 Q 镇，时速 80 km/h，下午 3:30 到达。司机 B 比 A 晚 2 小时出发，时速 100 km/h。(a) 司机 B 什么时候到达 Q 镇？(b) B 要和 A 同时到达 Q，需要多快？

en: Train A travelled from town X to town Z at 160 km/h. Train B took 6 hours to travel the same distance. Both the trains passed town Y at 2 pm and train B arrived at town Z at 4 pm. If town Y was 400 km away from town Z, (a) what time did train A leave town X? (b) what time did train A reach town Z?
zh: 火车 A 从 X 镇到 Z 镇，时速 160 km/h。火车 B 走同样距离用 6 小时。两列火车都在下午 2 点经过 Y 镇，B 下午 4 点到达 Z。Y 到 Z 距离 400 km。(a) A 什么时候离开 X？(b) A 什么时候到达 Z？

en: A large warehouse had a total of 4000 towels for sale. The ratio of the number of blue towels to red towels was 2:1. The rest were white towels. After 1/4 of the blue towels and 1/2 of the white towels were sold, there were 2400 towels left. How many red and white towels were there at first?
zh: 一家大仓库有 4000 条毛巾要卖。蓝色和红色毛巾的比是 2:1，其余是白色。卖掉 1/4 的蓝毛巾和 1/2 的白毛巾之后剩下 2400 条。原来红色和白色毛巾各有多少条？

steps.label: 找关系
steps.text: 蓝 = 红 × 2，所以卖掉的蓝（蓝的 1/4）= 红的一半。

steps.label: 算卖掉
steps.text: 共卖掉 4000 − 2400 = 1600 条 = 红的一半 + 白的一半，所以 红 + 白 = 3200 条。

model.text: 红毛巾原有 400 条，白毛巾原有 2800 条。

en: Paul puts some beads in 3 jars, A, B and C. The ratio of the number of beads in jar A to jar B is 2:3. The ratio of the number of beads in jar B to jar C is 2:1. If Paul transfers an equal number of beads from jar B to jars A and C, he will have an equal number of beads in jars A and B and the total number of beads in jar C will increase to 297. Find the total number of beads in the three jars.
zh: Paul 把珠子装进 3 个罐子 A、B、C。A:B = 2:3, B:C = 2:1。如果 Paul 从 B 罐往 A 和 C 各转同样多珠子，A 和 B 会相等，而 C 会增加到 297 颗。求 3 罐珠子的总数。

steps.label: 设转移
steps.text: 从 B 给 A、C 各转 x 颗后 A 和 B 相等：4u + x = 6u − 2x，得 x = 2u/3。

model.text: 三个罐子里一共有 1053 颗珠子。

en: 1/3 of the people at a party are men. When half of the number of men leave the party, there are 96 more women than men. If 8 women leave the party, find the ratio of the number of men to the number of women who remain at the party.
zh: 派对上 1/3 是男人。一半男人离开派对后，女人比男人多 96。再离开 8 个女人后，派对上男人和女人的比是多少？

en: Cindy and Mark had a total of 80 marbles in the ratio 3:2. After giving away some of her marbles, Cindy had 1/4 as many marbles as Mark. How many marbles did Cindy give away?
zh: Cindy 和 Mark 一共有 80 颗弹珠，比例 3:2。Cindy 送出一些弹珠后，Cindy 的弹珠是 Mark 的 1/4。Cindy 送出了多少颗？

en: In a country club, the ratio of the number of men to women was 2:3. 1/4 of the men and 1/2 of the women left the club. The number of people who remained in the club was 24 more than the number of people who left. How many people were in the club at first?
zh: 一家乡村俱乐部里男女比 2:3。1/4 的男人和 1/2 的女人离开后，留下的人比离开的多 24 人。俱乐部原来有多少人？

en: Mandy and Jack had some sweets in the ratio 5:7. After Mandy gave Jack some sweets, the ratio of the number of sweets that Mandy had to the number of sweets Jack had was 3:21 (1:7). If Jack had 168 sweets at first, how many sweets should Jack return to Mandy so that both of them would then have an equal number of sweets?
zh: Mandy 和 Jack 的糖数量比是 5:7。Mandy 给 Jack 一些糖后，Mandy 和 Jack 糖数的比变成 1:7。Jack 原来有 168 颗糖。Jack 要把多少颗糖还给 Mandy，两人糖数才一样多？

en: Some sweets were placed in 3 containers, A, B and C. The ratio of the sweets in A to B was 7:4 and the ratio of the sweets in B to C was 3:2. After 36 sweets were taken from A, the number of sweets in C was 2/3 the number of sweets in A. What was the total number of sweets left in the three containers?
zh: 一些糖放在 3 个容器 A、B、C 里。A:B = 7:4, B:C = 3:2。从 A 取走 36 颗后，C 的数量是 A 的 2/3。3 个容器里最后一共还剩多少糖？

en: There are 1580 adults and children on a ship. 60% of them are adults. When the ship stops at the harbour, some of the adults alight and the percentage of adults remaining on the ship decreases to 20%. (a) How many adults alight from the ship? (b) What is the ratio of children to adults who remain on the ship?
zh: 一艘船上有 1580 个大人和孩子。60% 是大人。船靠港后，一些大人下船，船上大人比例降到 20%。(a) 下船的大人有多少人？(b) 留在船上的孩子与大人的比是多少？

en: Mrs Gibbs sold some chocolate cakes and Mrs Drew sold some strawberry cakes. Each chocolate cake cost $4 and each strawberry cake cost $3 more than 2 chocolate cakes. The number of cakes that Mrs Gibbs and Mrs Drew sold was in the ratio 5:3. If Mrs Gibbs sold 8 more cakes than Mrs Drew, how much money did they collect altogether from the sales of the cakes?
zh: Gibbs 太太卖了一些巧克力蛋糕，Drew 太太卖了一些草莓蛋糕。每个巧克力蛋糕 $4，每个草莓蛋糕比 2 个巧克力蛋糕贵 $3。两人卖的蛋糕数量比是 5:3。Gibbs 比 Drew 多卖 8 个。两人一共收了多少钱？

en: Susan, Mark and Jane sold some charity tickets which cost $1.20 each. Susan sold half of the charity tickets. Mark and Jane sold the rest of the charity tickets in the ratio 5:3. If Mark sold 18 more charity tickets than Jane, how much money did they collect in all?
zh: Susan、Mark 和 Jane 卖了一些慈善票，每张 $1.20。Susan 卖了一半。Mark 和 Jane 按 5:3 分剩下的票。Mark 比 Jane 多卖 18 张。三人一共收了多少钱？

en: A sum of money was shared between Alvin, Zachary and Philip in the ratio 2:5:3 respectively. After Zachary spent 20% of his money, the amount he had left was $196 less than the total amount of money that Alvin and Philip had. How much more money did Alvin and Zachary had than Philip at first?
zh: 一笔钱按 2:5:3 分给 Alvin、Zachary 和 Philip。Zachary 花了自己钱的 20% 之后，他剩下的钱比 Alvin 和 Philip 的钱总和少 $196。原来 Alvin 和 Zachary 一共比 Philip 多多少钱？

en: 40% of the adults left the party before it ended. 10% of those who left were men. The ratio of the number of men who left the party to the men who remained behind was 2:5. If there were 105 men at the party at first, how many women were at the party at first?
zh: 派对结束前 40% 的大人离开。走的人里 10% 是男人。走的男人与留下的男人的比是 2:5。派对原来有 105 个男人。派对原来有多少女人？

en: Kate, Melissa, Ann and Jack shared a jar of biscuits. Kate took 30% of the biscuits and Melissa took 25% of the biscuits. Jack took the remaining 80 biscuits. Ann took 20 more biscuits than Melissa. What percentage of the biscuits did Ann take from the jar?
zh: Kate、Melissa、Ann 和 Jack 分一罐饼干。Kate 拿了 30%，Melissa 拿了 25%。Jack 拿了剩下的 80 块。Ann 比 Melissa 多拿了 20 块。Ann 拿了整罐饼干的百分之几？

en: Uncle Sam sells cups at a shop. For every cup that he sells, he collects 20% of the price of the cup. For every 10 cups that he sells, he earns an extra 5% of the price of a cup. A cup is sold for $8. If he collects $86.80, how many cups does he sell?
zh: Sam 叔叔在一家店卖杯子。每卖一个杯子，他拿杯价的 20%。每卖 10 个，再额外拿杯价的 5%。每个杯子 $8。如果他一共收了 $86.80，他卖了多少个杯子？

model.text: Sam 叔叔一共卖了 53 个杯子。

en: In a class, 20% of the students are boys. 20% of the boys and 10% of the girls keep pets. If 144 of the girls do not keep pets, how many children keep pets?
zh: 一个班里 20% 的学生是男生。男生的 20% 和女生的 10% 养宠物。如果有 144 个女生没养宠物，养宠物的孩子一共有多少人？

en: Samuel had some marbles. 2/5 of them were red. Of the remaining marbles, 10% of them were blue and 10% were green. The rest of the marbles were yellow. If there were 32 more yellow marbles than red marbles, find the total number of blue and green marbles.
zh: Samuel 有一些弹珠，2/5 是红色。剩下弹珠里 10% 是蓝色、10% 是绿色，其余是黄色。如果黄色比红色多 32 颗，蓝色和绿色一共多少颗？

en: Jane and Jeffrey had some marbles. Jane had 40% more marbles than Jeffrey. When Jane lost 12 marbles and gave 16 marbles to Jeffrey, both of them had an equal number of marbles. How many marbles did each of them have at first?
zh: Jane 和 Jeffrey 各有一些弹珠。Jane 比 Jeffrey 多 40%。Jane 丢了 12 颗又给 Jeffrey 16 颗后，两人弹珠数相等。两人原来各有多少？

en: Mrs Wood received a fixed monthly salary. She saved 10% of her salary in the first month. The following month, she saved 50% more than what she did in the first month. She saved $496.50 more on the second month than the first month. What was her total salary for half a year?
zh: Wood 太太每月领固定工资。第一个月她存了工资的 10%。第二个月她比第一个月多存 50%。第二个月比第一个月多存 $496.50。她半年的总工资是多少？

en: A figure is a square with an area of 625 cm². Find the percentage increase in area if the length of each side is increased by 40%.
zh: 一个正方形面积 625 cm²。如果每条边都增加 40%，面积增加百分之多少？

en: 80% of the books in a box are second-hand books and the rest are new books. 10% of the new books and 60% of the second-hand books are English books and the rest are Chinese books. After another 15 English books are placed in the box, the ratio of English books to Chinese books is 3:2. (a) How many English books are there in the box at first? (b) What is the total number of books in the box in the end?
zh: 一个盒子里 80% 的书是二手书，其余是新书。新书的 10% 和二手书的 60% 是英文书，其余是中文书。再放入 15 本英文书后，英文书和中文书的比变成 3:2。(a) 盒子里原来有多少本英文书？(b) 最后盒子里一共有多少本书？

en: In January, Joyce kept 80% of her salary of which she then gave 1/5 to her mother and saved the rest. The rest of her money was spent on food and clothing. In February, she gave her mother $150 more than the amount she had given her in January. The amount given to her mother was then equal to the amount she saved. She spent the same amount on food and clothing in January and February. (a) What was the percentage increase in the amount Joyce gave to her mother in February? (b) How much did Joyce spend on food and clothing in each month?
zh: 1 月 Joyce 留下工资的 80%，再把其中的 1/5 给妈妈，其余存起来。剩下的 20% 花在了伙食和衣服上。2 月她给妈妈的钱比 1 月多 $150，这时给妈妈的钱和存的钱相等。1 月和 2 月在伙食衣服上花的钱相同。(a) 2 月给妈妈的钱比 1 月多了百分之几？(b) 每月花在伙食和衣服上多少钱？

steps.label: 拆一月
steps.text: 设月薪 S：一月留下 80% = 0.8S，给妈妈 1/5 × 0.8S = 0.16S，存下 0.64S，伙食衣服 0.2S。

model.text: (a) 增加了 150%；(b) 每月伙食和衣服花 $125。

en: There were 4500 seats in a theatre. 10% of the seats were first-class, 30% were second-class seats and the rest were third-class seats. Another 200 first-class and 250 second-class seats were added to the theatre. (a) How many first-class seats were there in the end? (b) How many second-class seats were there in the end? (c) What percentage of the seats were third-class in the end? (Leave your answer in fraction.)
zh: 剧院有 4500 个座位。其中 10% 是一等座，30% 是二等座，其余是三等座。后来又加了 200 个一等座和 250 个二等座。(a) 最后有多少一等座？(b) 多少二等座？(c) 三等座占总座位的百分之几？（答案用分数表示。）

en: Jeremy and Alicia had a total of $360. Jeremy had $24 more than Alicia. Alicia spent 3 times as much money as Jeremy and was left with 50% of the amount of money Jeremy had left. (a) How much did Jeremy have at first? (b) How much had Jeremy left?
zh: Jeremy 和 Alicia 一共有 $360。Jeremy 比 Alicia 多 $24。Alicia 花的钱是 Jeremy 的 3 倍，剩下的钱是 Jeremy 剩下钱的 50%。(a) Jeremy 原来有多少钱？(b) Jeremy 最后剩多少钱？

en: There were 207 pears and 176 mangoes in crate A. There were 293 pears and 274 mangoes in crate B. Robert moved some pears and mangoes from crate B to crate A. In the end, 40% of the fruit in crate A and 70% of the fruit in crate B were pears. How many pieces of fruit did Robert move from crate B to crate A?
zh: A 箱里有 207 个梨和 176 个芒果，B 箱里有 293 个梨和 274 个芒果。Robert 从 B 箱移了一些梨和芒果到 A 箱。最后 A 箱里 40% 是梨，B 箱里 70% 是梨。Robert 从 B 箱一共移了多少个水果到 A 箱？
